items.title: 跌時加碼！輝達開盤暴跌逾14% 散戶半小時買盤超正常40倍　單日淨買入破1.1億美元創九年新高
items.title_en: Buy the Dip! Nvidia Plunges Over 14% at Open, Retail Investors Buy 40 Times Normal in Half an Hour, Net Daily Purchase Exceeds $110 Million, a Nine-Year High
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳週四(12日)無預警卸任並退出董事會，股價劇震，開盤一度暴跌逾14%，終場收跌4.3%，單日市值蒸發約1820億美元，但在市場恐慌之際，散戶卻掀起創紀錄的抄底潮。
《金融時報》報導，根據Vanda Research數據，輝達週四開盤僅半小時便錄得1.11億美元散戶淨買超，超過正常水準40倍，刷新2017年以來紀錄。該股在週一(9日)至週三(11日)均居散戶淨買超榜首，吸金約13.1億美元。
另據富達數據，截至美股週四午盤，客戶買單近39.5萬筆，遠超8萬筆賣單，做多熱情亦蔓延至槓桿ETF。
相較之下，華爾街轉趨審慎。自那斯達克五週前觸頂以來，輝達累計下跌近三分之一，市值縮水逾1兆美元。Baird分析師將其評級降至「中立」，目標價大砍60%至200美元，主要因為供應掣肘與需求隱憂恐削弱2027年資料中心業務能見度。
此次震盪源於黃仁勳近期爆發的婚外情醜聞與治理問題。掌舵輝達33年的他週四離職，由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)出任臨時執行長，公司正物色繼任者。
不過，惠靈頓資產管理公司與Blue Whale基金等機構認為，輝達未來兩三年產品路線已定，短期換帥難改基本面。市場焦點轉向下週發布的財報，新管理層對AI前景的闡述將是檢驗信心關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang unexpectedly stepped down and left the board on Thursday (the 12th), sending the stock into a frenzy; it briefly tumbled more than 14% at the open and closed down 4.3%, wiping about $182 billion off its market value in a single day, yet amid the panic retail investors launched a record‑breaking buying spree.

The Financial Times reported that, according to Vanda Research data, Nvidia recorded a net retail buy of $111 million within just half an hour of Thursday’s open – more than 40 times the normal level and the strongest since 2017. The stock topped the retail net‑buy list from Monday (the 9th) through Wednesday (the 11th), pulling in roughly $1.31 billion.

Fidelity data showed that by the U.S. market’s midday on Thursday, customers had placed about 395,000 buy orders versus just over 80,000 sell orders, and the buying enthusiasm also spread to leveraged ETFs.

In contrast, Wall Street grew more cautious. Since the Nasdaq peak five weeks ago, Nvidia has fallen nearly one‑third, erasing over $1 trillion in market cap. Baird analysts cut the rating to "Neutral" and slashed the price target by 60% to $200, citing supply constraints and demand uncertainties that could dim the outlook for its 2027 data‑center business.

The turmoil stems from a recent extramarital affair scandal involving Jensen Huang and governance concerns. After steering Nvidia for 33 years, he left on Thursday, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor.

However, Wellington Management and the Blue Whale fund argue that Nvidia’s product roadmap is set for the next two‑to‑three years, and a short‑term leadership change won’t alter the fundamentals. Market attention now shifts to next week’s earnings release, where the new management’s view on AI will be the key test of confidence.

items.title: 民主黨展開輝達調查：質疑黃仁勳與川普的晶片交易與2600萬美元政治捐款
items.title_en: Democrats Launch Nvidia Probe, Questioning Jensen Huang’s Chip Deal with Trump and $26 Million Political Donation
paras: 美國國會民主黨高層周四(12日)針對川普政府處理輝達(NVDA-US)對中國晶片銷售案正式展開調查。眾議院歲入委員會資深民主黨議員尼爾(Richard Neal)與參議院財政委員會資深民主黨議員懷登(Ron Wyden)聯名致函美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)，要求商務部妥善保存與此晶片交易相關的所有記錄與文件。
此項調查啟動之際，輝達前執行長黃仁勳才剛因承認與婚外情而辭職下台。
在致盧特尼克的公開信中，尼爾與懷登詳細拆解了川普政府與輝達之間的交易模式：川普同意向中國出售輝達的 H200 與 H20 AI 晶片，但要求這些在台灣製造的晶片必須先運抵美國。晶片抵達美國後，川普政府隨即對其徵收關稅，形同抽成輝達與AMD(AMD-US)對中銷售額的 15% 至 25%，隨後商務部才核發出口許可證。
尼爾與懷登在信中指出：「計畫的運作方式如此……表面上看似建立了一套違憲的出口稅制度。」
兩位議員嚴厲批評川普引用 1962 年《貿易擴張法》第 232 條授權的作法，並在信中引述發言表示：「國會制定第 232 條是為了給予總統工具，針對其認定構成國家安全威脅的進口商品採取行動；川普對此法條的使用似乎恰恰相反，損害了美國的國家安全，並使美國人面臨風險。」
信中進一步強調：「川普政府表面上企圖將違憲的出口稅偽裝成國家安全關稅行動——同時使輝達和中國政府受益——這在我們委員會關於稅收和關稅的事務管轄範圍內引發了嚴重疑慮。」
除了出口機制外，民主黨調查同時指向商務部在國安審查上的重大漏洞。輝達在新加坡的客戶 Megaspeed 被美國官方懷疑協助將先進 AI 晶片轉運至中國，而此公司高層黃樂不僅被疑為中國情報人員，更與黃仁勳爆出婚外情關係。
信中質問商務部為何在情報部門提出警示後，仍持續批准 Megaspeed 購買晶片，甚至傳出商務部在輝達接觸後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查。對此，尼爾與懷登在信中明確抨擊：「商務部在批准這些輝達晶片的中資買家過程中，顯然嚴重缺乏盡職調查——鑑於有報導稱商務部在輝達外聯後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查，這一點尤為令人擔憂。」
此外，調查信函還質疑輝達向川普相關計畫捐贈 2,600 萬美元(包含白宮宴會廳建設)與交易案的關聯。議員指出，出口協議是在川普得知黃仁勳「處於被妥協的處境」及收到捐款後獲得批准，質疑川普是否利用其掌握婚外情的秘密來施壓索取政治捐款。
共和黨主導的國會小組(包含眾議院中共特別委員會、外交委員會與情報委員會)先前已要求黃仁勳出席閉門聽證會，黃仁勳已在周四辭職後同意作證。
川普日前在《60分鐘》專訪中曾提及，其團隊曾以入獄威脅一名未具名的 AI 高層，隨後這名高層「徹底改變」。截至目前，白宮與美國商務部尚未對民主黨議員的調查信函做出公開回應。
paras_en: U.S. House Democratic leaders on Thursday (the 12th) formally opened an investigation into the Trump administration’s handling of Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip sales to China. Senior Democratic members of the House Ways and Means Committee, Richard Neal, and the Senate Finance Committee, Ron Wyden, jointly wrote to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, demanding that the Commerce Department preserve all records and documents related to the chip transaction.
The probe was launched just as former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after admitting to an extramarital affair.

In their public letter to Lutnick, Neal and Wyden dissected the transaction model between the Trump administration and Nvidia: Trump agreed to allow Nvidia’s H200 and H20 AI chips—manufactured in Taiwan—to be shipped to the United States before being sent to China. Once the chips arrived in the U.S., the administration immediately imposed tariffs, effectively taking 15% to 25% of Nvidia’s and AMD’s (AMD-US) sales to China, after which the Commerce Department issued export licenses.
Neal and Wyden wrote in the letter, "The plan operates in this way… on its face it appears to create an unconstitutional export tax regime."

The two lawmakers harshly criticized Trump’s reliance on the 1962 Trade Expansion Act’s Section 232 authority, quoting his remarks: "Section 232 was enacted by Congress to give the President a tool to act against imports deemed a national‑security threat; Trump’s use of the provision seems to do the opposite, harming U.S. security and putting Americans at risk."

The letter further emphasized, "The Trump administration’s attempt to disguise an unconstitutional export tax as a national‑security tariff—while benefiting Nvidia and the Chinese government—raises serious concerns within our committee’s jurisdiction over tax and tariff matters."

Beyond the export mechanism, the Democratic inquiry also points to a major flaw in the Commerce Department’s national‑security review. Nvidia’s Singapore customer Megaspeed is suspected by U.S. officials of funneling advanced AI chips to China, and its executive Huang Le is alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative and linked to Jensen Huang’s affair.

The letter asks why the Commerce Department continued to approve Megaspeed’s chip purchases after intelligence agencies raised warnings, and even reportedly halted its independent investigation of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s involvement. Neal and Wyden state, "The Commerce Department clearly lacked due diligence in approving these Chinese‑linked buyers of Nvidia chips—especially concerning reports that it paused its independent probe of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s outreach, which is deeply troubling."

The investigators also question the $26 million donation that Nvidia made to Trump‑related projects (including the White House’s banquet hall construction) and its connection to the deal. Lawmakers note the export agreement was approved after Trump learned that Jensen Huang was "in a compromised position" and had received the donation, suggesting Trump may have leveraged the affair’s secrecy to extract political contributions.

A Republican‑led congressional panel (including the House China‑related Special Committee, the Foreign Affairs Committee and the Intelligence Committee) had previously subpoenaed Huang for a closed‑door hearing; Huang agreed to testify after resigning on Thursday.

Trump recently told "60 Minutes" that his team once threatened to imprison an unnamed AI executive, after which the executive "completely changed"; to date, neither the White House nor the Commerce Department has publicly responded to the Democrats’ investigative letter.

items.title: 經部亞灣25家新創發表AI應用 攜手微軟Google助攻南台灣產業轉型
items.title_en: 25 Startups at Kaohsiung Asia Bay Showcase AI Applications, Partnering with Microsoft and Google to Boost Southern Taiwan Industry Transformation
paras: 經濟部中小及新創企業署為提升產業合作效益，今（13）日於高雄亞灣新創園展現今年度AI創新實證計畫成果。中企署攜手微軟與Google等國際大廠資源，媒合新創企業與南台灣在地產業進行場域驗證。富強鑫、大武山與勁豐等上市櫃公司皆透過AI解決方案大幅縮短作業時間並提升產能效率，加速南台灣產業鏈智慧化與落地應用，帶動中小微企業數位轉型。
中企署本周於亞灣新創園辦理實證暨園區成果發表會，集結25家新創企業展示創新解決方案，並舉辦技術論壇與產業交流。該計畫聚焦南台灣車用電子、塑橡膠化工、食品加工及物流運籌等四大產業領域需求。透過盤點企業在研發、生產製造、品質檢測及訂單管理等環節面臨的問題，成功媒合新創技術促成AI解決方案進入企業實際場域驗證，成效斐然。
在實際導入效益方面，雲界數位透過AI技術協助塑膠設備大廠富強鑫 (6603-TW) 進行跨機台參數分析，將原需2.5小時的分析作業縮短至10分鐘，大幅提升廠區設備整體運作效率。達易智造則透過AI智慧排程，協助上市蛋品業者大武山 (6952-TW) 將每日供貨調配時間由4小時縮減至1.2小時，精準供貨給大型通路與連鎖餐廳。
海波視智能則協助勁豐 (6577-TW) 導入高光譜與影像辨識技術，提升品質檢測準確度與一致性，展現AI技術解決產業痛點的實力。為強化新創研發及市場拓展能量，中企署結合微軟與Google等科技大廠，提供技術支援、專業課程、算力點數及行銷網絡等輔導資源，並共同舉辦論壇分享專題與應用座談，加速創新技術從場域驗證走向商業市場。
亞灣新創園與高雄軟體園區未來將持續串聯產官學研各界，強化新創培育、專利布局與財務資源鏈結。透過引進更多數位科技，中企署期盼將AI解決方案導入製造、服務與農林漁牧等南台灣重點產業，推動中小微企業全面轉型升級。同時將提供更豐沛的算力與AI工具支持，規劃加速器補助方案幫助新創拓展國內外市場，預計明年初就會陸續推出具體措施。
經濟部強調未來將持續推動創新實驗機制，針對金融科技、無人機、無人載具及無人車等新興應用領域，積極協調相關法規與試驗需求。透過結合Google、微軟以及AWS等國際指標性企業與產學研夥伴，期盼能打造出更完整且具備高度彈性的新創合作平台。不僅要加速在地產業升級步伐，更要為台灣新創圈及整體經濟產業發展注入全新的強大動能。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs' Small and Medium Enterprise Administration held a showcase today (13th) at Kaohsiung Asia Bay Innovation Park to present the results of this year’s AI innovation pilot projects, aiming to enhance industry collaboration. Partnering with global giants such as Microsoft and Google, the agency matched startups with local southern‑Taiwan industries for field validation. Listed companies including Fu‑Chuang‑Xin, Da‑Wu‑Shan and Jin‑Feng have leveraged AI solutions to dramatically cut processing times and improve production efficiency, accelerating the smart‑ification and practical application of the southern Taiwan supply chain and driving digital transformation for SMEs.

The agency hosted a pilot‑project results presentation at Asia Bay Innovation Park this week, gathering 25 startups to display innovative solutions and holding a technical forum and industry exchange. The program focuses on four key sectors in southern Taiwan—automotive electronics, plastics‑rubber chemicals, food processing, and logistics. By identifying pain points in R&D, manufacturing, quality inspection and order management, the initiative successfully matched startup technologies with corporate needs, enabling AI solutions to be tested in real‑world settings with impressive outcomes.

In terms of concrete benefits, CloudRealm Digital used AI to help major plastics equipment maker Fu‑Chuang‑Xin (6603‑TW) perform cross‑machine parameter analysis, reducing a task that previously took 2.5 hours to just 10 minutes and markedly boosting overall equipment efficiency. Da‑Yi Smart Manufacturing applied AI‑driven scheduling for listed egg producer Da‑Wu‑Shan (6952‑TW), cutting daily delivery‑allocation time from four hours to 1.2 hours and enabling precise supply to large retailers and chain restaurants.

Hai‑Bo Vision Intelligence assisted Jin‑Feng (6577‑TW) in adopting hyperspectral and image‑recognition technologies, improving the accuracy and consistency of quality inspections and demonstrating AI’s power to solve industry pain points. To strengthen startup R&D and market expansion, the agency teamed up with Microsoft, Google and other tech leaders to provide technical support, professional courses, compute credits and marketing networks, and co‑hosted forums and application panels to accelerate the move from field validation to commercial market.

Asia Bay Innovation Park and the Kaohsiung Software Park will continue to link government, academia and industry, enhancing startup incubation, patent strategies and financial resource connections. By introducing more digital technologies, the agency hopes to embed AI solutions across manufacturing, services and agriculture, fisheries and livestock in southern Taiwan, promoting comprehensive upgrades for SMEs. It will also offer richer compute power and AI tools, design accelerator subsidies to help startups expand domestically and abroad, with concrete measures slated for early next year.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs stressed that it will keep advancing innovative testing mechanisms, focusing on emerging areas such as fintech, drones, unmanned vehicles and autonomous cars, actively coordinating relevant regulations and trial needs. By collaborating with international benchmarks like Google, Microsoft and AWS, together with academia and research partners, the goal is to build a more complete and highly flexible startup cooperation platform, not only speeding up local industry upgrades but also injecting new, strong momentum into Taiwan’s startup ecosystem and overall economic development.

items.title: 輝達5000億美元AI融資計畫傳數月掛蛋！ 客戶要求提高擔保 黃仁勳離開後前景添變數
items.title_en: Nvidia's $500 Billion AI Financing Plan Said to Be Stalled for Months! Customers Demand Higher Guarantees, Jensen Huang's Exit Adds Uncertainty
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)長期執行長黃仁勳8月與全球六大資產管理公司共同推動規模達5000億美元的人工智慧(AI)融資平台，有知情人士透露，由於這幾個月未能促成任何交易，過去一個月以來已有部分客戶及華爾街合作夥伴，要求輝達提高融資擔保規模。
輝達8月表示，將提供所謂的「剩餘價值支持協議」(residual value support agreement)，承擔每筆交易最高25%的風險，比率低於競爭對手博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)提供的水準。部分知情人士指出，這項差距增加了促成交易的難度。
其中一人認為，輝達最快可能要到明年1月才能宣布任何交易，這還得建立在黃仁勳因婚外情傳聞戲劇化下台之際，不會有任何交易、甚至整個計畫因此生變的前提上。
響應的六大資產管理公司分別是阿波羅全球管理(Apollo Global Management)、貝萊德(BlackRock)(BLK-US)、黑石(Blackstone)(BX-US)、Brookfield Asset Management、高盛(GS-US)及KKR。

AI晶片融資市場快速擴張 「剩餘價值擔保」成關鍵

過去一年來，晶片債務融資市場規模迅速擴大。OpenAI、Anthropic 及SpaceX(SPCX-US)等大型業者，為了取得執行專門AI任務所需的昂貴處理器，正尋求各種融資管道，相關支出已超過數千億美元。
一般而言，企業會設立特殊目的公司(SPV)，透過發行債務籌措資金並持有晶片，再將晶片租賃給客戶。這些特殊目的公司的價值，來自客戶使用相關技術所簽訂合約產生的現金流，以及晶片本身的價值。
然而，貸款機構擔心持續燒錢的企業可能違約、不再支付租金，因此輝達與博通提供的剩餘價值擔保，對吸引貸款機構至關重要。
這類擔保的運作方式是：如果租賃付款中止，相關資產會重新出租或出售，用來償還剩餘債務。若所得金額仍不足以償還債務，則由提供擔保的一方補足差額。
這種機制不僅能吸引更多貸款機構參與交易，也有助於取得較高的信用評等，進而降低借貸成本。博通已開始透過今年6月與阿波羅及黑石成立的AI XPV合作平台，推動這類交易。

博通擔保比率達72.5% 輝達支持力度相形見絀

博通今年5月為一筆350億美元的債務交易提供300億美元擔保，該筆交易與Anthropic租用由博通及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google製造的TPU有關。博通提供擔保的債務部分取得投資等級評等，並享有較低利率。
另一筆規模630億美元的交易也意在支撐Anthropic。根據申報文件，博通將為其中72.5%的金額提供擔保，相當於約430億美元，這筆融資中，優先順位的第一順位擔保部分由美國銀行(BAC-US)、花旗集團(C-US)及摩根士丹利(MS-US)安排，至於第二順位融資中已承諾的部分，則由黑石單獨提供。還有一部分債務預定明年第1季出售給更廣泛的貸款機構。
如果輝達不願提高目前25%的剩餘價值擔保比例，可能使AI及雲端服務客戶更無力負擔採用輝達晶片的成本，也會降低貸款機構參與交易的意願。尤其當市場同時推出條件更優惠的類似交易時，輝達的方案將更難吸引資金。
對輝達而言，提高擔保比例也意味著必須承擔更高風險，並可能削弱原本希望透過第三方資金擴大融資平台、推動AI熱潮下一階段成長的目的。

黃仁勳離開後 誰能建立市場信心？

在黃仁勳下台後，輝達本身的前景正遭到質疑，因為過去30年來黃仁勳一直是這家公司的唯一執行長。
輝達周四宣布，財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)將接任臨時執行長，黃仁勳則將不再與這家公司有任何關聯。
在黃仁勳的領導下，輝達曾被稱為「AI的中央銀行」，透過在整個產業生態系中投資入股及提供融資擔保，替這個還在萌芽階段的產業建立信心。
今年8月宣布的融資計畫就是基於這個精神。當時，高盛、黑石及阿波羅花了好幾個月籌備債務交易，卻始終未能促成交易。黃仁勳仍公開讚揚這項規模5000億美元的計畫，表示這將替輝達的客戶提供融資，而這些客戶正是支撐輝達未來需求的關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) long‑time CEO Jensen Huang in August teamed up with six major global asset managers to push a $500 billion artificial‑intelligence (AI) financing platform. Insiders say that because no deals have been closed in recent months, some customers and Wall Street partners have, over the past month, asked Nvidia to increase the size of its financing guarantees.

In August Nvidia said it would offer a so‑called “residual‑value support agreement,” covering up to 25% of the risk on each transaction – a lower ratio than competitor Broadcom (AVGO-US) provides. Some insiders noted that this gap makes it harder to close deals.

One source believes Nvidia may not announce any transaction until as late as January next year, and that this assumes Jensen Huang’s dramatic exit amid extramarital‑affair rumors does not cause any deals—or the whole programme—to collapse.
The six responding asset managers are Apollo Global Management, BlackRock (BLK-US), Blackstone (BX-US), Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and KKR.

AI‑chip financing is expanding rapidly, with “residual‑value guarantees” becoming critical. Over the past year the chip‑debt market has grown quickly. Large players such as OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX (SPCX-US) are seeking financing to buy costly processors needed for dedicated AI workloads, with related spending now exceeding hundreds of billions of dollars.

Typically, companies set up special‑purpose vehicles (SPVs) that issue debt to raise cash, hold the chips, and then lease the chips to customers. The value of these SPVs comes from the cash flows generated by the customers’ technology‑use contracts and the chips themselves.
However, lenders worry that cash‑burning companies might default and stop paying lease fees, so the residual‑value guarantees offered by Nvidia and Broadcom are crucial for attracting lenders.

The guarantee works like this: if lease payments stop, the underlying assets are re‑leased or sold to repay the remaining debt. If the proceeds are still insufficient, the guarantor covers the shortfall.

This mechanism not only draws more lenders into the transaction but also helps achieve higher credit ratings, thereby lowering borrowing costs. Broadcom has already begun promoting such deals through the AI XPV platform it launched in June with Apollo and Blackstone.

Broadcom’s guarantee rate reaches 72.5%, dwarfing Nvidia’s support. In May Broadcom guaranteed $30 billion of a $35 billion debt deal tied to Anthropic’s lease of TPUs made by Broadcom and Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google, giving the debt an investment‑grade rating and a lower interest rate.

Another $63 billion transaction also aims to back Anthropic. According to filing documents, Broadcom will guarantee 72.5% of the amount – about $43 billion – with first‑lien guarantees arranged by Bank of America (BAC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US). The second‑lien portion already pledged is being provided solely by Blackstone, and part of the debt is slated for sale to a broader pool of lenders in Q1 2025.

If Nvidia refuses to raise its current 25% residual‑value guarantee, AI and cloud‑service customers may find it harder to afford Nvidia chips, and lenders may be less willing to participate. When the market offers similarly structured deals with more favorable terms, Nvidia’s offering will struggle to attract capital.

For Nvidia, raising the guarantee ratio also means taking on higher risk, potentially undermining the original goal of using third‑party capital to expand the financing platform and drive the next phase of AI‑driven growth.
Who can rebuild market confidence after Jensen Huang’s departure? After Huang steps down, Nvidia’s outlook is being questioned because he has been the company’s sole CEO for the past three decades.
Nvidia announced on Thursday that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO, and Jensen Huang will have no further ties to the company.
Under Huang’s leadership, Nvidia was dubbed the “central bank of AI,” investing in and providing financing guarantees across the industry ecosystem to build confidence in this still‑emerging sector.

The financing plan announced in August was based on that spirit. At the time, Goldman Sachs, Blackstone and Apollo spent months preparing a debt transaction but never succeeded in closing a deal. Huang publicly praised the $500 billion plan, saying it would finance Nvidia’s customers, who are the key to supporting Nvidia’s future demand.

items.title: 算力超級周期邁入分層時代 長鑫科技展示全場景記憶體新局
items.title_en: Supercomputing Cycles Enter Layered Era as Changxin Technology Showcases New All-Scenario Memory Landscape
paras: 第二十三屆中國國際半導體博覽會(IC China 2026)於11月12日開幕，長鑫科技集中展示面向伺服器、智慧型手機與汽車三大場景的記憶體產品矩陣。
長鑫科技副總裁駱曉東在展會演講中指出，受全球算力需求激增推動，算力超級周期正進入全新的「分層時代」，記憶體產業競爭已從單一性能指標的比拼，全面轉向全場景產品布局能力的競爭。

駱曉東解析儲存新賽局

駱曉東分析，算力分層首先體現在細分市場需求的分化上：伺服器市場需求占比已突破50%，增量優先流向AI大型語言模型與智算中心等高價值場景；汽車市場預計至2030年複合成長率約30%；手機、PC等消費電子市場隨AI功能滲透加速，但仍具周期波動特徵。
另一方面，不同AI應用對記憶體的要求亦呈現顯著差異：大模型推理解碼階段受記憶體頻寬限制，長文本處理凸顯算力瓶頸，而超大參數多卡訓練則對記憶體容量與互連能力提出極高要求。

布局三大場景

為對應分層需求，長鑫科技首展三大主線產品：
伺服器領域：駱曉東表示，具備低延遲與高性價比優勢的RDIMM仍是伺服器記憶體核心。長鑫DDR5顆粒已迭代至32Gb，RDIMM模組涵蓋32GB至128GB主流容量段及5600Mbps至8000Mbps速率；MRDIMM最高速率更達12800Mbps，搶攻大容量高頻寬資料中心市場。
裝置端AI領域：長鑫展示全球首發量產的LPDDR6，最高傳輸速率達12800Mbps，較上一代LPDDR5X頻寬提升60%、功耗降低20%，並已率先搭載於小米18 Fold折疊旗艦手機落地商用。
汽車領域：因應寬溫與振動等複雜工況，長鑫最新車規級LPDDR5X通過AEC-Q100 Grade 2與ISO 26262 ASIL D雙重認證，並提供315焊球及441焊球兩種封裝方案，滿足智慧駕駛對高安全與高頻寬的需求。

研發加碼與技術轉型

技術研發方面，長鑫科技2026年前三季度研發投入達110.71億元人民幣，年增73.03%。其展出的第五代技術平台(G5)採用四重曝光工藝，將有源區半間距微縮至11.95奈米，每片晶圓的裸晶產出量提升至少50%。
面對DRAM供不應求的產業窗口期，長鑫表示已與多家頭部客戶簽署長期供貨合約。隨著DDR5與LPDDR6等高附加值產品放量，四季度及2027年營收預計將維持成長態勢，持續強化全場景儲存底座。
paras_en: The 23rd China International Semiconductor Expo (IC China 2026) opened on November 12, with Changxin Technology focusing on a memory product matrix for servers, smartphones, and automotive scenarios.

Changxin Technology Vice President Luo Xiaodong highlighted in his keynote that the surge in global computing demand is driving the supercomputing cycle into a new "layered era," where competition in the memory industry has shifted from a single performance metric to a comprehensive all-scenario product portfolio.

Luo Xiaodong explained the new storage landscape: computing layers first manifest in the diversification of market demand—server demand now accounts for over 50%, with incremental growth flowing to high-value scenarios such as AI large language models and intelligent computing centers; the automotive market is projected to grow at a compound annual rate of about 30% by 2030; consumer electronics like phones and PCs are accelerating AI feature penetration but still exhibit cyclical volatility.

Different AI applications also show significant differences in memory requirements: large model decoding is limited by memory bandwidth, long-text processing highlights computing bottlenecks, while ultra-large-parameter multi-card training demands extremely high memory capacity and interconnect capability.
To meet layered demands, Changxin Technology unveiled three main product lines:

In the server domain, Luo Xiaodong noted that RDIMM, with its low latency and high cost-performance advantage, remains the core of server memory. Changxin's DDR5 chips have been upgraded to 32 Gb, with RDIMM modules covering mainstream capacities from 32 GB to 128 GB and speeds from 5600 Mbps to 8000 Mbps; MRDIMM reaches a top speed of 12800 Mbps, targeting high-capacity, high-bandwidth data center markets.

In the device-side AI domain, Changxin showcased the world’s first mass-produced LPDDR6, with a maximum transfer rate of 12800 Mbps—an increase of 60% over the previous LPDDR5X bandwidth and a 20% reduction in power consumption—and it has already been deployed in Xiaomi’s 18 Fold foldable flagship phone for commercial use.

In the automotive domain, responding to complex conditions such as wide temperature ranges and vibration, Changxin’s latest automotive-grade LPDDR5X has passed AEC‑Q100 Grade 2 and ISO 26262 ASIL D dual certifications, and offers 315-ball and 441-ball package options to meet the high safety and high bandwidth needs of intelligent driving.

In terms of R&D, Changxin Technology invested 11.071 billion RMB in research and development during the first three quarters of 2026, a year-on-year increase of 73.03%. Its showcased fifth-generation technology platform (G5) uses a quadruple-exposure process, shrinking the active area half-pitch to 11.95 nm and increasing wafer yield by at least 50%.

Facing a supply-demand gap in the DRAM industry, Changxin stated it has signed long-term supply contracts with several leading customers. With high-value products such as DDR5 and LPDDR6 ramping up, revenue is expected to continue growing in Q4 and 2027, further strengthening the all-scenario storage foundation.

items.title: 黃仁勳閃辭震撼輝達！傳數百員工聯名盼老闆回歸「他值得第二次機會」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Abrupt Resignation Shocks Nvidia; Hundreds of Employees Petition for His Return, Claim He Deserves a Second Chance
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 捲入婚外情與國安風波，週四 (12 日) 辭去執行長、總裁及董事職務，公司內部隨即傳出要求他回鍋的聲音。美國科技媒體《WIRED》報導，一篇在黃仁勳請辭前發布的內部意見箱貼文已累計逾 1,600 則留言，多數支持他繼續掌舵。另有數百名員工聯名請願，要求黃仁勳復職，並呼籲現任董事辭職下台。
員工聲援之際，輝達也面臨股價下跌與華府調查壓力。
《華爾街見聞》報導，自相關指控曝光以來，輝達市值一度蒸發逾 1 兆美元，美國國會議員和聯邦調查局 (FBI) 也相繼啟動調查。該報導另援引預測市場平台 Kalshi 的數據稱，約九成輝達員工希望黃仁勳留任，但未交代數據如何蒐集。
據《WIRED》查閱的內部通訊，輝達一名資深工程師在黃仁勳宣布請辭前，曾透過公司意見箱呼籲董事會在採取任何行動前，先徵詢員工對黃仁勳去留的看法，並公開調查結論。
這篇貼文後來也成為員工呼籲黃仁勳回歸的管道。
「如果你相信這家公司的使命，就把老闆請回來。」一名匿名員工在留言中寫道。另一人則表示，「我們都是人，都會犯錯。黃仁勳做了很多好事，他值得第二次機會。」
一名員工也寄信給全體員工，要求董事會更透明地交代黃仁勳離職的經過。「我支持黃仁勳，並不是因為我認為他不會犯錯，而是因為我不願相信，堅持公平就得與一位對我們如此重要的領導者劃清界線。」這名員工在信中寫道。
聲援也延伸到公開平台。
《WIRED》指出，黃仁勳辭職消息公布後數小時內，有 20 多名輝達員工在 LinkedIn 發文表達支持，其中一人表示，對黃仁勳領導能力的信心始終沒有動搖。
該媒體在同一時段搜尋，未發現輝達員工公開發文支持他離任。
一名在輝達任職數年、未獲公司授權公開發言的員工告訴《WIRED》，希望黃仁勳回歸的聲音在公司內部相當普遍。這名員工擔心，失去創辦人掌舵後，輝達可能逐步走下坡，並直言，「輝達之所以是今天的輝達，是因為黃仁勳。」
據報導，輝達本週營運照常，但董事會在內部調查尚未結束之際宣布黃仁勳請辭，令許多員工感到錯愕，也有人要求董事會說明為何在此時作出人事決定。
輝達已任命財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 兼任代理執行長，由哈維．瓊斯 (Harvey C. Jones) 出任董事長，董事會將從公司內外物色正式接班人。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang was embroiled in an extramarital affair and national security controversy, and on Thursday (12th) he resigned as CEO, president, and director, prompting immediate calls within the company for his return. U.S. tech media WIRED reported that an internal suggestion box post released before Huang’s resignation had accumulated over 1,600 comments, most of which supported him continuing to steer the company. Hundreds of employees also signed a petition demanding Huang’s reinstatement and calling for the resignation of current directors.
While employees rallied in support, Nvidia also faced falling stock prices and pressure from Washington investigations.

According to Wall Street Journal, since the allegations surfaced, Nvidia’s market value once evaporated more than $1 trillion, and U.S. Congress members and the FBI have both launched investigations. The report also cited data from market platform Kalshi, claiming that about ninety percent of Nvidia employees want Huang to stay, though it did not explain how the data were collected.

WIRED’s investigation of internal communications revealed that a senior engineer at Nvidia, before Huang announced his resignation, used the company suggestion box to urge the board to consult employees on Huang’s departure before taking any action and to publicly disclose the investigation’s findings.
That post later became a channel for employees to call for Huang’s return.

"If you believe in this company’s mission, bring the boss back," an anonymous employee wrote in a comment. Another said, "We’re all human and make mistakes. Huang has done many good things; he deserves a second chance."

An employee also sent a letter to all staff demanding the board be more transparent about the circumstances of Huang’s departure. "I support Huang, not because I think he won’t make mistakes, but because I refuse to believe that fairness requires drawing a line with a leader so vital to us," the employee wrote.
The support extended to public platforms.

WIRED noted that within hours of Huang’s resignation announcement, more than 20 Nvidia employees posted on LinkedIn expressing support, with one stating that his confidence in Huang’s leadership had never wavered.
During the same period, the media found no public posts from Nvidia employees supporting his departure.

A longtime Nvidia employee who was not authorized to speak publicly told WIRED that calls for Huang’s return were common within the company. The employee worried that without the founder at the helm, Nvidia might gradually decline, and bluntly said, "Nvidia is what it is today because of Huang."

Reports say Nvidia’s operations continued as usual this week, but the board announced Huang’s resignation while an internal investigation was still ongoing, leaving many employees shocked and some demanding an explanation for the timing of the personnel decision.
Nvidia has appointed CFO Colette Kress as acting CEO, with Harvey C. Jones as chairman, and the board will look for a permanent successor both inside and outside the company.

items.title: 日月光高雄路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土 千億布局擴大先進封裝量能
paras: 日月光持續擴大在台先進封裝布局，今（13）日於南部科學園區高雄園區舉行「日月光南科分公司路竹廠一期啟用暨二期動土典禮」，此次亦為日月光首度進駐科學園區興建大型先進封裝廠房。
典禮由日月光總部執行副總經理洪松井、國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局局長鄭秀絨、日月光南科分公司總經理王頌斐等產官代表共同出席見證。路竹廠一期與二期滿載後，整體投資規模預估達新台幣千億元，年營收約800億元，預計創造約5,000個就業機會，總樓地板面積約6.61萬坪，並於楠梓總部核心基地之外，打造日月光另一個先進封裝重要據點。
隨著人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）等新世代應用快速發展，市場對高效能晶片及先進封裝需求持續成長。日月光此次以一期啟用、二期擴建同步推進，將先進封裝布局由楠梓向北延伸至路竹，進一步串聯南台灣晶圓製造、封裝測試及上下游供應鏈，縮短產業鏈距離、提升協同效率，強化南台灣半導體產業聚落的整體競爭力。
日月光總部執行副總經理洪松井表示，AI與高效能運算快速發展，持續推升高階晶片對先進封裝技術與量產能力的需求。先進封裝已成為半導體產業推動運算效能持續提升的重要關鍵，日月光持續提前布局產能、技術與人才，透過楠梓與路竹等據點相互支援，強化先進封裝製造量能與供應鏈協同。
日月光南科分公司總經理王頌斐表示，路竹廠一期正式啟用、二期同步動土，不僅是日月光首度進駐科學園區的重要里程碑，也代表公司持續以長期投資回應全球客戶需求，深化台灣在全球半導體供應鏈中的競爭優勢。
路竹廠一期為日月光進駐科學園區的重要起點。為加速先進封裝產能布局，日月光先前投入新台幣65億元取得南部科學園區高雄園區既有廠房及附屬設施，並進行廠房整合與產線建置，逐步導入先進封裝量能。此次一期正式啟用，象徵日月光在路竹的先進封裝布局由投資建置進入實質營運階段，也為後續二期擴建奠定生產、人才與供應鏈基礎。
二期亦將進一步強化製造環境穩定度與營運韌性，透過微振控制設計，並將特殊氣體供應、公共危險物品管理及廢水處理等廠務設施採分棟配置，降低相互干擾並提升風險隔離能力，為下一階段先進封裝量產與未來擴充預留更大的發展空間。
南部科學園區管理局局長鄭秀絨表示，南科持續完善園區及周邊醫療、教育與交通等生活機能，打造兼顧生產、生活與生態的優質園區環境，並持續推動園區版圖由嘉義、臺南、高雄延伸至屏東，串聯南臺灣半導體產業廊帶，落實「大南方新矽谷」發展布局。
日月光此次進駐南科高雄園區並擴大先進封裝量能，將進一步強化晶圓製造、封裝測試與上下游供應鏈的產業鏈結，帶動人才、研發及產業資源匯聚，為南臺灣半導體聚落注入新的發展動能。
日月光深耕高雄逾40年，以楠梓為核心持續拓展在地先進封測版圖，此次首度進駐科學園區，進一步將產業布局延伸至路竹。從一期投資建置到二期擴大布局，不僅持續提升先進封裝量能，也將帶動周邊供應鏈、人才與產學研發能量匯聚。
未來，日月光將持續深化先進封裝與智慧製造布局，強化台灣半導體產業的量產效率與供應鏈韌性，以長期投資深耕台灣、根留高雄，迎接AI世代下一階段成長需求。

items.title: 0050 10月定期定額突破130億元年增127% 0056同步締新猷
items.title_en: 0050 October regular‑investment contributions exceed NT$13 billion, up 127% year‑over‑year; 0056 also sets new record
paras: 台股 10 月遭遇國際資金調節修正，第四法人展現成熟投資人姿態，不僅逢低進場ETF，元大台灣50(0050-TW)單月扣款金額更突破130億元，領軍全市場，單月定期定額扣款金額寫下375億元新高紀錄；元大高股息(0056-TW)亦衝破22億元，同締新猷。
投信投顧公會公布10月定額定額數據，0050單月扣款金額創130.6億元新高，較2025年同期增加73.1億元，年增達127%，穩居市場第一；第二名0056單月扣款金額22.1億元，同步創下新高，兩檔佔全體定期定額金額比重近半。
法人分析，0050為成立最久的市值型ETF，指數邏輯歷經多空考驗，無人為選股錯誤並與時俱進，完整參與台股與企業成長。0056則聚焦具獲利與配息潛力的企業，近年來受惠於AI需求強勁，推升0056股價、配息表現同步走升，進一步強化長期配置吸引力。
0050成立以來至11/12累積報酬達2,197 %，換算年化報酬率約15%，等於資金投入約5年即可翻倍成長，持續吸引投資人數、定期定額戶數與扣款金額持續突破新高，位居台股ETF領先地位。
法人分析，台股修正之際，投資人展現「成熟投資人」操作策略，除把握大跌當日積極進場，定期定額亦不減反增。今年以來至11/12，0050累積淨申購金額達8,909億元，已是2025年全年的2.6倍，挑戰全年兆元。
隨著投資人從交易走向配置，緊抱指數成為震盪行情中的投資主旋律，未來有望為台股反彈動能增添助力，更成為支撐後續多頭行情的重要基石。

paras_en: In October, Taiwan stocks faced international capital adjustments, and the fourth‑institution investors showed a mature investor stance by buying ETFs on dips. Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) saw its monthly contribution amount break through NT$13 billion, leading the whole market, and the monthly systematic investment plan (SIP) total hit a new high of NT$37.5 billion. Yuanta High Dividend (0056‑TW) also surged past NT$2.2 billion, setting a new milestone.

The Investment Trust and Investment Advisory Association released October SIP data, showing 0050’s monthly contribution reached a record NT$130.6 billion, an increase of NT$73.1 billion from the same month in 2025, a 127% year‑over‑year rise, keeping it the market leader. The runner‑up, 0056, posted a monthly contribution of NT$22.1 billion, also a new high, and the two funds together accounted for nearly half of all systematic‑investment amounts.

Analysts note that 0050 is the longest‑standing market‑cap‑weighted ETF; its index methodology has survived both bullish and bearish tests, avoids human stock‑picking errors, and evolves with the market, fully participating in Taiwan’s equity and corporate growth. 0056 focuses on companies with strong earnings and dividend‑paying potential, and has recently benefited from robust AI demand, which lifted both its price and dividend performance, further enhancing its long‑term appeal.

Since its inception, 0050 has accumulated a total return of 2,197% as of November 12, equivalent to an annualized return of about 15%, meaning an investment can double in roughly five years. Investor numbers, SIP accounts, and contribution amounts continue to hit new highs, cementing its leading position among Taiwan‑stock ETFs.

Analysts observe that during the market correction, investors displayed a “mature investor” strategy, seizing the day of a sharp drop to buy aggressively while increasing, not decreasing, their SIP contributions. From the start of the year through November 12, 0050’s net subscription amount reached NT$890.9 billion, already 2.6 times the total for the entire year of 2025, challenging the trillion‑NTD mark for the full year.

As investors shift from trading to allocation and embrace index investing as the main theme in a volatile market, this approach is expected to add momentum to a Taiwan‑stock rebound and become a key foundation supporting future bullish trends.

items.title: 經部亞灣25家新創發表AI應用 攜手微軟Google助攻南台灣產業轉型
items.title_en: 25 Startups at Kaohsiung Asia Bay Showcase AI Applications, Partnering with Microsoft and Google to Boost Southern Taiwan Industry Transformation
paras: 經濟部中小及新創企業署為提升產業合作效益，今（13）日於高雄亞灣新創園展現今年度AI創新實證計畫成果。中企署攜手微軟與Google等國際大廠資源，媒合新創企業與南台灣在地產業進行場域驗證。富強鑫、大武山與勁豐等上市櫃公司皆透過AI解決方案大幅縮短作業時間並提升產能效率，加速南台灣產業鏈智慧化與落地應用，帶動中小微企業數位轉型。
中企署本周於亞灣新創園辦理實證暨園區成果發表會，集結25家新創企業展示創新解決方案，並舉辦技術論壇與產業交流。該計畫聚焦南台灣車用電子、塑橡膠化工、食品加工及物流運籌等四大產業領域需求。透過盤點企業在研發、生產製造、品質檢測及訂單管理等環節面臨的問題，成功媒合新創技術促成AI解決方案進入企業實際場域驗證，成效斐然。
在實際導入效益方面，雲界數位透過AI技術協助塑膠設備大廠富強鑫 (6603-TW) 進行跨機台參數分析，將原需2.5小時的分析作業縮短至10分鐘，大幅提升廠區設備整體運作效率。達易智造則透過AI智慧排程，協助上市蛋品業者大武山 (6952-TW) 將每日供貨調配時間由4小時縮減至1.2小時，精準供貨給大型通路與連鎖餐廳。
海波視智能則協助勁豐 (6577-TW) 導入高光譜與影像辨識技術，提升品質檢測準確度與一致性，展現AI技術解決產業痛點的實力。為強化新創研發及市場拓展能量，中企署結合微軟與Google等科技大廠，提供技術支援、專業課程、算力點數及行銷網絡等輔導資源，並共同舉辦論壇分享專題與應用座談，加速創新技術從場域驗證走向商業市場。
亞灣新創園與高雄軟體園區未來將持續串聯產官學研各界，強化新創培育、專利布局與財務資源鏈結。透過引進更多數位科技，中企署期盼將AI解決方案導入製造、服務與農林漁牧等南台灣重點產業，推動中小微企業全面轉型升級。同時將提供更豐沛的算力與AI工具支持，規劃加速器補助方案幫助新創拓展國內外市場，預計明年初就會陸續推出具體措施。
經濟部強調未來將持續推動創新實驗機制，針對金融科技、無人機、無人載具及無人車等新興應用領域，積極協調相關法規與試驗需求。透過結合Google、微軟以及AWS等國際指標性企業與產學研夥伴，期盼能打造出更完整且具備高度彈性的新創合作平台。不僅要加速在地產業升級步伐，更要為台灣新創圈及整體經濟產業發展注入全新的強大動能。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs' Small and Medium Enterprise Administration held a showcase today (13th) at Kaohsiung Asia Bay Innovation Park to present the results of this year’s AI innovation pilot projects, aiming to enhance industry collaboration. Partnering with global giants such as Microsoft and Google, the agency matched startups with local southern‑Taiwan industries for field validation. Listed companies including Fu‑Chuang‑Xin, Da‑Wu‑Shan and Jin‑Feng have leveraged AI solutions to dramatically cut processing times and improve production efficiency, accelerating the smart‑ification and practical application of the southern Taiwan supply chain and driving digital transformation for SMEs.

The agency hosted a pilot‑project results presentation at Asia Bay Innovation Park this week, gathering 25 startups to display innovative solutions and holding a technical forum and industry exchange. The program focuses on four key sectors in southern Taiwan—automotive electronics, plastics‑rubber chemicals, food processing, and logistics. By identifying pain points in R&D, manufacturing, quality inspection and order management, the initiative successfully matched startup technologies with corporate needs, enabling AI solutions to be tested in real‑world settings with impressive outcomes.

In terms of concrete benefits, CloudRealm Digital used AI to help major plastics equipment maker Fu‑Chuang‑Xin (6603‑TW) perform cross‑machine parameter analysis, reducing a task that previously took 2.5 hours to just 10 minutes and markedly boosting overall equipment efficiency. Da‑Yi Smart Manufacturing applied AI‑driven scheduling for listed egg producer Da‑Wu‑Shan (6952‑TW), cutting daily delivery‑allocation time from four hours to 1.2 hours and enabling precise supply to large retailers and chain restaurants.

Hai‑Bo Vision Intelligence assisted Jin‑Feng (6577‑TW) in adopting hyperspectral and image‑recognition technologies, improving the accuracy and consistency of quality inspections and demonstrating AI’s power to solve industry pain points. To strengthen startup R&D and market expansion, the agency teamed up with Microsoft, Google and other tech leaders to provide technical support, professional courses, compute credits and marketing networks, and co‑hosted forums and application panels to accelerate the move from field validation to commercial market.

Asia Bay Innovation Park and the Kaohsiung Software Park will continue to link government, academia and industry, enhancing startup incubation, patent strategies and financial resource connections. By introducing more digital technologies, the agency hopes to embed AI solutions across manufacturing, services and agriculture, fisheries and livestock in southern Taiwan, promoting comprehensive upgrades for SMEs. It will also offer richer compute power and AI tools, design accelerator subsidies to help startups expand domestically and abroad, with concrete measures slated for early next year.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs stressed that it will keep advancing innovative testing mechanisms, focusing on emerging areas such as fintech, drones, unmanned vehicles and autonomous cars, actively coordinating relevant regulations and trial needs. By collaborating with international benchmarks like Google, Microsoft and AWS, together with academia and research partners, the goal is to build a more complete and highly flexible startup cooperation platform, not only speeding up local industry upgrades but also injecting new, strong momentum into Taiwan’s startup ecosystem and overall economic development.

items.title: 不只0050與高股息！從10大熱門ETF排行，一次看懂最新存股風向與績效表現
items.title_en: Not Just 0050 and High Dividend! Understanding the Latest Stock‑Saving Trend and Performance from the Top 10 Popular ETFs at Once
paras: 證交所公布 2026 年 10 月最新 ETF 定期定額交易戶數，市值型龍頭 0050 單月激增逾 3.3 萬戶、正式突破 130 萬大關；高股息陣營則出現榜首更替，0056 反超 00878 重回第二。除了全市場趨勢，永豐金證券「豐存股」榜單更顯示不配息的 009816 躍居亞軍，究竟存股族配置策略出現哪些新風向？本文帶您一次掌握最新數據與存股績效！
一、2026年10月存股族最愛10檔ETF

根據臺灣證券交易所截至2026年10月的最新定期定額交易戶數統計，最受存股族青睞的10大ETF依序為：元大台灣50（0050）、元大高股息（0056）、國泰永續高股息（00878）、富邦台50（006208）、群益台灣精選高息（00919）、主動統一台股增長(00981A) 、凱基台灣TOP50 (009816)、富邦科技(0052)、國泰台灣科技龍頭（00881），以及元大台灣高息低波（00713） 。
證交所最新公佈 10 月定期定額交易戶數，0050（元大台灣50）持續發揮龍頭效果，單月大增超過 3.3 萬戶，總戶數突破 130 萬大關；高股息領域則出現榜首更替，0056（元大高股息）反超 00878（國泰永續高股息）重回第二。此外，主動型與新一代市值型 ETF 如 00981A 及 009816 戶數亦穩定成長，顯示市場在參與大盤趨勢的同時，配置策略更趨多元。
0050 戶數持續擴大，市值型龍頭地位穩固：10 月交易戶數由 9 月的 1,275,993 戶大幅成長至 1,309,883 戶，單月激增 33,890 戶。大盤高檔震盪之際，0050 依舊是定期定額投資人長期參與台股成長的首選標的。
高股息榜首翻轉，0056 成長力道強勁：10 月 0056 戶數增加 11,946 戶至 344,256 戶，超越 00878（10 月小幅減少 3,677 戶至 333,543 戶），重回定期定額高股息第一大標的，顯示長牌高股息的配息穩定度深受存股族青睞。

items.title: 日月光高雄路竹廠一期啟用、二期動土 千億布局擴大先進封裝量能
paras: 日月光持續擴大在台先進封裝布局，今（13）日於南部科學園區高雄園區舉行「日月光南科分公司路竹廠一期啟用暨二期動土典禮」，此次亦為日月光首度進駐科學園區興建大型先進封裝廠房。
典禮由日月光總部執行副總經理洪松井、國家科學及技術委員會南部科學園區管理局局長鄭秀絨、日月光南科分公司總經理王頌斐等產官代表共同出席見證。路竹廠一期與二期滿載後，整體投資規模預估達新台幣千億元，年營收約800億元，預計創造約5,000個就業機會，總樓地板面積約6.61萬坪，並於楠梓總部核心基地之外，打造日月光另一個先進封裝重要據點。
隨著人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）等新世代應用快速發展，市場對高效能晶片及先進封裝需求持續成長。日月光此次以一期啟用、二期擴建同步推進，將先進封裝布局由楠梓向北延伸至路竹，進一步串聯南台灣晶圓製造、封裝測試及上下游供應鏈，縮短產業鏈距離、提升協同效率，強化南台灣半導體產業聚落的整體競爭力。
日月光總部執行副總經理洪松井表示，AI與高效能運算快速發展，持續推升高階晶片對先進封裝技術與量產能力的需求。先進封裝已成為半導體產業推動運算效能持續提升的重要關鍵，日月光持續提前布局產能、技術與人才，透過楠梓與路竹等據點相互支援，強化先進封裝製造量能與供應鏈協同。
日月光南科分公司總經理王頌斐表示，路竹廠一期正式啟用、二期同步動土，不僅是日月光首度進駐科學園區的重要里程碑，也代表公司持續以長期投資回應全球客戶需求，深化台灣在全球半導體供應鏈中的競爭優勢。
路竹廠一期為日月光進駐科學園區的重要起點。為加速先進封裝產能布局，日月光先前投入新台幣65億元取得南部科學園區高雄園區既有廠房及附屬設施，並進行廠房整合與產線建置，逐步導入先進封裝量能。此次一期正式啟用，象徵日月光在路竹的先進封裝布局由投資建置進入實質營運階段，也為後續二期擴建奠定生產、人才與供應鏈基礎。
二期亦將進一步強化製造環境穩定度與營運韌性，透過微振控制設計，並將特殊氣體供應、公共危險物品管理及廢水處理等廠務設施採分棟配置，降低相互干擾並提升風險隔離能力，為下一階段先進封裝量產與未來擴充預留更大的發展空間。
南部科學園區管理局局長鄭秀絨表示，南科持續完善園區及周邊醫療、教育與交通等生活機能，打造兼顧生產、生活與生態的優質園區環境，並持續推動園區版圖由嘉義、臺南、高雄延伸至屏東，串聯南臺灣半導體產業廊帶，落實「大南方新矽谷」發展布局。
日月光此次進駐南科高雄園區並擴大先進封裝量能，將進一步強化晶圓製造、封裝測試與上下游供應鏈的產業鏈結，帶動人才、研發及產業資源匯聚，為南臺灣半導體聚落注入新的發展動能。
日月光深耕高雄逾40年，以楠梓為核心持續拓展在地先進封測版圖，此次首度進駐科學園區，進一步將產業布局延伸至路竹。從一期投資建置到二期擴大布局，不僅持續提升先進封裝量能，也將帶動周邊供應鏈、人才與產學研發能量匯聚。
未來，日月光將持續深化先進封裝與智慧製造布局，強化台灣半導體產業的量產效率與供應鏈韌性，以長期投資深耕台灣、根留高雄，迎接AI世代下一階段成長需求。

items.title: 萬海陳柏廷罕露臉喊：油價回不去 海運已是「有序競爭」
items.title_en: Wan Hai Chairman Chen Bo-ting Rarely Appears, Says Oil Prices Won’t Return and Shipping Is Already in “Orderly Competition”
paras: 貨櫃航商萬海(2615-TW)董事長陳柏廷今(13)日罕見露面並表示，未來兩年市況不錯，事實上，每年各界講供需結構其實不是很大重點，「everything都回不去，不只是油價這件事情」。
陳柏廷說，業內和外界每年講海運供需，其實沒有講到重點，供過於求可能是假議題。
原因在於，地緣的武裝組織改變規矩、現在連碼頭也改變規矩 ，「今年一下子中東叫不到車、印度叫不到車」，而過往的世界工廠中國upgrade更注重環保議題，再加上美中貿易戰造成製造商移轉，造成很多事情都回不去。
陳柏廷強調，海運沒有那麼差，也不是說一定景氣循環，已是「有序競爭」的結構。
陳柏廷不諱言，投資這麼大買船隊確實大股東會怕，但運輸業每個變數都在動，「供給和需求不是書本上那種供需，供給其實相對固定」，因此，態度是積極中帶有保守，慢慢在看但態度open。
陳柏廷反問「為什麼運費一定要變成以前那樣」，其實everthing都回不去，不只是油價這件事情、綠能和環保、人權等都是有代價的，海運成本也節節攀升，當然不需要殺價。
paras_en: Container shipping company Wan Hai (2615‑TW) Chairman Chen Bo‑ting made a rare public appearance today (the 13th) and said the market outlook for the next two years is good. In fact, the annual discussions about supply‑demand structure are not the main point – “everything won’t go back, not just oil prices.”
Chen said that both the industry and outsiders talk about shipping supply‑demand each year, but they miss the point; the notion of oversupply may be a false issue.

The reason is that geopolitical armed groups are changing the rules, and now even ports are changing the rules. “This year, you can’t get trucks in the Middle East or India,” and China, the former world factory, is upgrading with a stronger focus on environmental issues. On top of that, the US‑China trade war has forced manufacturers to relocate, making many things irreversible.
Chen emphasized that shipping is not that bad, nor is it guaranteed to be in a boom‑or‑bust cycle; it has already become a structure of “orderly competition.”

Chen admitted that large shareholders may fear massive fleet purchases, but every variable in the transport industry is shifting. “Supply and demand are not the textbook kind; supply is actually relatively fixed,” so the stance is cautiously optimistic – watching carefully while remaining open.

Chen asked, “Why must freight rates revert to how they used to be?” In fact, everything won’t go back, not just oil prices. Green energy, environmental concerns, human rights and other factors all come at a cost, and shipping costs keep climbing, so there’s no need to slash prices.

items.title: 台灣寵物經濟規模直逼千億！毛孩數「超車」0-14歲兒童52萬 職缺爆增24%
items.title_en: Taiwan's Pet Economy Approaches NT$1 Trillion, With Pets Outnumbering Children Aged 0-14 by 520,000 and Job Openings Surging 24%
paras: 台灣少子化與高齡化趨勢加劇，寵物晉升家庭核心成員，催生龐大毛孩經濟。全台犬貓總數逾320萬隻，超越幼童高達52萬，這股反轉推升寵物市場規模朝1000億元邁進。市場爆發帶動相關職缺成長24%，產業分工更趨細緻化。獸醫均薪衝破67000元，寵物生命禮儀等服務快速崛起，千億寵物經濟已成內需強勁動能，吸引跨領域人才投入。
農業部調查指出，全台家犬與家貓合計突破320萬隻，相對於0至14歲幼童僅剩268.2萬人，毛孩數量大幅超車逾52萬。這股反轉改變社會情感寄託，台經院預估未來3年內，台灣整體寵物市場規模有望突破1000億元大關。2026年全台預計舉辦33場寵物展覽，顯示照護與消費需求持續擴大，產業發展潛力無窮。
千億商機在就業市場掀起新革命。1111人力銀行觀察，2026年寵物相關工作機會較去年成長近24%，3年內職缺成長達33%。寵物相關服務職缺年增約13.5%；動物醫院中，獸醫與診所助理需求甚至出現翻倍成長。寵物消費從基本飼料，延伸至專業美容、住宿、訓練、醫療及日常照護，帶動整體產業升級。
薪資表現上，動物醫院獸醫與獸醫佐2026年均薪達67416元，較2024年的61438元增加約9.7%；診所助理均薪約39542元，年增8.2%。寵物相關服務業2026年均薪約45258元，最高薪為業務主管，均薪達59416元。相關工作不再僅憑喜歡動物就能勝任，更需要專業知識與業務拓展能力。
隨著毛孩地位提升，寵物生命禮儀等身後事產業規模也日益擴大。財政部數據顯示，台灣殯葬業2023年銷售額達155.8億元，其中寵物屍體處理營業額約1.3億元。雖然占比仍低，但營業額5年內激增9.8倍，臨終送行商機正快速加溫。人力銀行庫中，寵物生命禮儀職缺年增3成，3年以上資深人員月薪上看5萬元，成為新興亮點。
1111人力銀行發言人曾仲葳表示，寵物職涯發展日趨多元，求職者可依自身專長選擇方向。具醫療專業可朝高階獸醫發展；具服務熱忱可投入美容與旅宿，品牌業務與營運管理也有機會切入市場。但商機成長不代表能快速上手，專業照護仍須具備資格與訓練。求職者應評估專業門檻與工時，累積經驗才能精準找到職涯定位。
paras_en: Taiwan's declining birthrate and aging population are driving pets to become core family members, spawning a massive "pet child" economy. The total number of dogs and cats nationwide exceeds 3.2 million, surpassing the 520,000‑strong cohort of children aged 0‑14. This reversal is pushing the pet market toward a NT$1‑trillion scale. The market boom has lifted related job openings by 24%, and industry segmentation is becoming increasingly refined. Veterinarians now earn an average salary of over NT$67,000, and services such as pet funeral rites are rapidly emerging. The trillion‑dollar pet economy has become a strong domestic growth engine, attracting talent from various fields.

A survey by the Council of Agriculture shows that the combined number of household dogs and cats in Taiwan has broken through 3.2 million, while the population of children aged 0‑14 has fallen to 2.682 million, meaning pets outnumber children by more than 520,000. This shift is changing how society places emotional attachment, and the Taiwan Economic Research Institute projects that within three years the overall pet market could exceed NT$1 trillion. In 2026, Taiwan is expected to host 33 pet exhibitions, indicating that care and consumption demand continue to expand and that the industry's development potential is boundless.

The trillion‑dollar opportunity is sparking a new revolution in the employment market. 1111 Job Bank observes that pet‑related job opportunities in 2026 have grown nearly 24% compared with the previous year, with a 33% increase in openings over three years. Annual growth for pet‑service positions is about 13.5%; demand for veterinarians and clinic assistants in animal hospitals has even doubled. Pet spending has expanded from basic feed to professional grooming, boarding, training, medical care, and daily care, driving overall industry upgrading.

In terms of compensation, the average salary for veterinarians and veterinary assistants in animal hospitals is projected to reach NT$67,416 in 2026, up about 9.7% from NT$61,438 in 2024. Clinic assistants are expected to earn an average of NT$39,542, an 8.2% annual increase. The average salary in pet‑related service industries in 2026 is about NT$45,258, with the highest pay for business managers at NT$59,416. These roles now require professional knowledge and business development skills, not just a love of animals.

As pets gain higher status, the post‑mortem industry for pet funeral rites is also expanding. Ministry of Finance data show that Taiwan's funeral industry generated NT$15.58 billion in sales in 2023, of which pet corpse handling accounted for about NT$130 million. Although still a small share, revenue has surged 9.8‑fold over five years, and end‑of‑life services are heating up quickly. In job banks, pet funeral‑service openings have risen 30% annually, and senior staff with over three years of experience can earn up to NT$50,000 per month, making it an emerging highlight.

1111 Job Bank spokesperson Zeng Zhong‑wei said that pet career paths are becoming increasingly diverse, allowing job seekers to choose directions based on their strengths. Those with medical expertise can pursue senior veterinary roles; those passionate about service can enter grooming or boarding, while brand sales and operations management also offer market entry points. However, growing opportunities do not mean easy entry—professional care still requires qualifications and training. Job seekers should assess professional thresholds and working hours, and accumulate experience to precisely locate their career niche.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉SpaceX星艦試飛在即 穩懋亮燈漲停板領PA三雄齊揚
items.title_en: Focus Stock: SpaceX Starship Test Flight Near, Wenmao Hits Limit Up Leading PA Trio to Surge
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)公布星艦第15次試飛計畫，最快於台北時間明(14)日發射，加上Singulus宣布將與SpaceX簽下第一條異質接面太陽能電池產線合約，金額超過6千萬歐元，將在明(2027)年交貨。
消息也帶動低軌衛星、PA功率放大器族群今(13)日齊夯，穩懋(3105-TW)開盤迅速跳空衝上漲停價586元，盤中雖打開鎖漲停，仍也領PA廠全新(2455-TW)、宏捷科(8086-TW)一度飆漲半根漲停板。
據外電報載，繼前次完成入軌與衛星部署後，這次SpaceX試飛重點將延伸至上下級回收，在26顆衛星部署後，需展開天線與太陽能板、建立通訊連結並提升軌道，SpaceX預期，完成相關檢查後，最快可在發射後數周內開始服務用戶。
低軌衛星通訊需要高頻率與高功率的訊號傳輸，包括化合物半導體(砷化鎵、氮化鎵)PA為SpaceX 難以自行製造的關鍵零組件。法人估與PA有關功率廠有受惠利多。
法人指出，穩懋具備全球砷化鎵晶圓代工龍頭地位，包括航太、衛星與光通訊布局也被視為行情的重要支撐題材。
在技術結構上，穩懋今日較昨(12)日量縮近1.5萬以上，在量增價揚下，股價站上所有均線之上，短中期均線呈多頭排列，RSI與日KD、月KD同步向上，顯示技術動能維持偏強格局，成交量近期連續3日放大並超過2萬張以上，量價配合上，有利於股價維持高檔整理。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) announced its 15th Starship test flight, which could launch as early as tomorrow (the 14th) Taipei time, and Singulus said it will sign the first heterogeneous‑junction solar cell production line contract with SpaceX, worth over €60 million, with delivery slated for 2027.

The news also sparked a rally in low‑Earth‑orbit satellite and PA power‑amplifier stocks on the 13th, with Wenmao (3105‑TW) gapping up to the limit‑up price of NT$586 at the open. Although the limit‑up was briefly lifted intraday, Wenmao still led the PA makers, with newcomers 2455‑TW and Hongjieke (8086‑TW) each soaring about half a limit‑up board.

According to foreign reports, after completing orbital insertion and satellite deployment in its previous mission, this SpaceX test flight will focus on both upper‑ and lower‑stage recovery. Following the deployment of 26 satellites, the vehicle will need to extend its antennas and solar panels, establish communications links, and raise its orbit. SpaceX expects that after the necessary checks, service to customers could begin within a few weeks of launch.

Low‑Earth‑orbit satellite communications require high‑frequency, high‑power signal transmission, and compound‑semiconductor (GaAs, GaN) power amplifiers are key components that SpaceX cannot manufacture in‑house. Institutional investors estimate that PA‑related power‑device manufacturers will benefit.

Institutions note that Wenmao holds a leading global position in GaAs wafer foundry services, with aerospace, satellite and optical‑communication portfolios that are seen as important support themes for the market.

Technically, Wenmao’s volume today was more than 15,000 shares lower than yesterday (the 12th). With the rise in price on lower volume, the stock is trading above all moving averages, and short‑ to medium‑term averages are in a bullish arrangement. RSI and daily and monthly KD indicators are all moving upward, indicating a still‑strong technical momentum. Trading volume has expanded for three consecutive days, exceeding 20,000 contracts, and the price‑volume alignment supports the stock’s ability to maintain a high‑level consolidation.

items.title: 跌時加碼！輝達開盤暴跌逾14% 散戶半小時買盤超正常40倍　單日淨買入破1.1億美元創九年新高
items.title_en: Buy the Dip! Nvidia Plunges Over 14% at Open, Retail Investors Buy 40 Times Normal in Half an Hour, Net Daily Purchase Exceeds $110 Million, a Nine-Year High
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳週四(12日)無預警卸任並退出董事會，股價劇震，開盤一度暴跌逾14%，終場收跌4.3%，單日市值蒸發約1820億美元，但在市場恐慌之際，散戶卻掀起創紀錄的抄底潮。
《金融時報》報導，根據Vanda Research數據，輝達週四開盤僅半小時便錄得1.11億美元散戶淨買超，超過正常水準40倍，刷新2017年以來紀錄。該股在週一(9日)至週三(11日)均居散戶淨買超榜首，吸金約13.1億美元。
另據富達數據，截至美股週四午盤，客戶買單近39.5萬筆，遠超8萬筆賣單，做多熱情亦蔓延至槓桿ETF。
相較之下，華爾街轉趨審慎。自那斯達克五週前觸頂以來，輝達累計下跌近三分之一，市值縮水逾1兆美元。Baird分析師將其評級降至「中立」，目標價大砍60%至200美元，主要因為供應掣肘與需求隱憂恐削弱2027年資料中心業務能見度。
此次震盪源於黃仁勳近期爆發的婚外情醜聞與治理問題。掌舵輝達33年的他週四離職，由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)出任臨時執行長，公司正物色繼任者。
不過，惠靈頓資產管理公司與Blue Whale基金等機構認為，輝達未來兩三年產品路線已定，短期換帥難改基本面。市場焦點轉向下週發布的財報，新管理層對AI前景的闡述將是檢驗信心關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang unexpectedly stepped down and left the board on Thursday (the 12th), sending the stock into a frenzy; it briefly tumbled more than 14% at the open and closed down 4.3%, wiping about $182 billion off its market value in a single day, yet amid the panic retail investors launched a record‑breaking buying spree.

The Financial Times reported that, according to Vanda Research data, Nvidia recorded a net retail buy of $111 million within just half an hour of Thursday’s open – more than 40 times the normal level and the strongest since 2017. The stock topped the retail net‑buy list from Monday (the 9th) through Wednesday (the 11th), pulling in roughly $1.31 billion.

Fidelity data showed that by the U.S. market’s midday on Thursday, customers had placed about 395,000 buy orders versus just over 80,000 sell orders, and the buying enthusiasm also spread to leveraged ETFs.

In contrast, Wall Street grew more cautious. Since the Nasdaq peak five weeks ago, Nvidia has fallen nearly one‑third, erasing over $1 trillion in market cap. Baird analysts cut the rating to "Neutral" and slashed the price target by 60% to $200, citing supply constraints and demand uncertainties that could dim the outlook for its 2027 data‑center business.

The turmoil stems from a recent extramarital affair scandal involving Jensen Huang and governance concerns. After steering Nvidia for 33 years, he left on Thursday, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor.

However, Wellington Management and the Blue Whale fund argue that Nvidia’s product roadmap is set for the next two‑to‑three years, and a short‑term leadership change won’t alter the fundamentals. Market attention now shifts to next week’s earnings release, where the new management’s view on AI will be the key test of confidence.

items.title: 民主黨展開輝達調查：質疑黃仁勳與川普的晶片交易與2600萬美元政治捐款
items.title_en: Democrats Launch Nvidia Probe, Questioning Jensen Huang’s Chip Deal with Trump and $26 Million Political Donation
paras: 美國國會民主黨高層周四(12日)針對川普政府處理輝達(NVDA-US)對中國晶片銷售案正式展開調查。眾議院歲入委員會資深民主黨議員尼爾(Richard Neal)與參議院財政委員會資深民主黨議員懷登(Ron Wyden)聯名致函美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)，要求商務部妥善保存與此晶片交易相關的所有記錄與文件。
此項調查啟動之際，輝達前執行長黃仁勳才剛因承認與婚外情而辭職下台。
在致盧特尼克的公開信中，尼爾與懷登詳細拆解了川普政府與輝達之間的交易模式：川普同意向中國出售輝達的 H200 與 H20 AI 晶片，但要求這些在台灣製造的晶片必須先運抵美國。晶片抵達美國後，川普政府隨即對其徵收關稅，形同抽成輝達與AMD(AMD-US)對中銷售額的 15% 至 25%，隨後商務部才核發出口許可證。
尼爾與懷登在信中指出：「計畫的運作方式如此……表面上看似建立了一套違憲的出口稅制度。」
兩位議員嚴厲批評川普引用 1962 年《貿易擴張法》第 232 條授權的作法，並在信中引述發言表示：「國會制定第 232 條是為了給予總統工具，針對其認定構成國家安全威脅的進口商品採取行動；川普對此法條的使用似乎恰恰相反，損害了美國的國家安全，並使美國人面臨風險。」
信中進一步強調：「川普政府表面上企圖將違憲的出口稅偽裝成國家安全關稅行動——同時使輝達和中國政府受益——這在我們委員會關於稅收和關稅的事務管轄範圍內引發了嚴重疑慮。」
除了出口機制外，民主黨調查同時指向商務部在國安審查上的重大漏洞。輝達在新加坡的客戶 Megaspeed 被美國官方懷疑協助將先進 AI 晶片轉運至中國，而此公司高層黃樂不僅被疑為中國情報人員，更與黃仁勳爆出婚外情關係。
信中質問商務部為何在情報部門提出警示後，仍持續批准 Megaspeed 購買晶片，甚至傳出商務部在輝達接觸後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查。對此，尼爾與懷登在信中明確抨擊：「商務部在批准這些輝達晶片的中資買家過程中，顯然嚴重缺乏盡職調查——鑑於有報導稱商務部在輝達外聯後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查，這一點尤為令人擔憂。」
此外，調查信函還質疑輝達向川普相關計畫捐贈 2,600 萬美元(包含白宮宴會廳建設)與交易案的關聯。議員指出，出口協議是在川普得知黃仁勳「處於被妥協的處境」及收到捐款後獲得批准，質疑川普是否利用其掌握婚外情的秘密來施壓索取政治捐款。
共和黨主導的國會小組(包含眾議院中共特別委員會、外交委員會與情報委員會)先前已要求黃仁勳出席閉門聽證會，黃仁勳已在周四辭職後同意作證。
川普日前在《60分鐘》專訪中曾提及，其團隊曾以入獄威脅一名未具名的 AI 高層，隨後這名高層「徹底改變」。截至目前，白宮與美國商務部尚未對民主黨議員的調查信函做出公開回應。
paras_en: U.S. House Democratic leaders on Thursday (the 12th) formally opened an investigation into the Trump administration’s handling of Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip sales to China. Senior Democratic members of the House Ways and Means Committee, Richard Neal, and the Senate Finance Committee, Ron Wyden, jointly wrote to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, demanding that the Commerce Department preserve all records and documents related to the chip transaction.
The probe was launched just as former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after admitting to an extramarital affair.

In their public letter to Lutnick, Neal and Wyden dissected the transaction model between the Trump administration and Nvidia: Trump agreed to allow Nvidia’s H200 and H20 AI chips—manufactured in Taiwan—to be shipped to the United States before being sent to China. Once the chips arrived in the U.S., the administration immediately imposed tariffs, effectively taking 15% to 25% of Nvidia’s and AMD’s (AMD-US) sales to China, after which the Commerce Department issued export licenses.
Neal and Wyden wrote in the letter, "The plan operates in this way… on its face it appears to create an unconstitutional export tax regime."

The two lawmakers harshly criticized Trump’s reliance on the 1962 Trade Expansion Act’s Section 232 authority, quoting his remarks: "Section 232 was enacted by Congress to give the President a tool to act against imports deemed a national‑security threat; Trump’s use of the provision seems to do the opposite, harming U.S. security and putting Americans at risk."

The letter further emphasized, "The Trump administration’s attempt to disguise an unconstitutional export tax as a national‑security tariff—while benefiting Nvidia and the Chinese government—raises serious concerns within our committee’s jurisdiction over tax and tariff matters."

Beyond the export mechanism, the Democratic inquiry also points to a major flaw in the Commerce Department’s national‑security review. Nvidia’s Singapore customer Megaspeed is suspected by U.S. officials of funneling advanced AI chips to China, and its executive Huang Le is alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative and linked to Jensen Huang’s affair.

The letter asks why the Commerce Department continued to approve Megaspeed’s chip purchases after intelligence agencies raised warnings, and even reportedly halted its independent investigation of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s involvement. Neal and Wyden state, "The Commerce Department clearly lacked due diligence in approving these Chinese‑linked buyers of Nvidia chips—especially concerning reports that it paused its independent probe of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s outreach, which is deeply troubling."

The investigators also question the $26 million donation that Nvidia made to Trump‑related projects (including the White House’s banquet hall construction) and its connection to the deal. Lawmakers note the export agreement was approved after Trump learned that Jensen Huang was "in a compromised position" and had received the donation, suggesting Trump may have leveraged the affair’s secrecy to extract political contributions.

A Republican‑led congressional panel (including the House China‑related Special Committee, the Foreign Affairs Committee and the Intelligence Committee) had previously subpoenaed Huang for a closed‑door hearing; Huang agreed to testify after resigning on Thursday.

Trump recently told "60 Minutes" that his team once threatened to imprison an unnamed AI executive, after which the executive "completely changed"; to date, neither the White House nor the Commerce Department has publicly responded to the Democrats’ investigative letter.

items.title: 輝達5000億美元AI融資計畫傳數月掛蛋！ 客戶要求提高擔保 黃仁勳離開後前景添變數
items.title_en: Nvidia's $500 Billion AI Financing Plan Said to Be Stalled for Months! Customers Demand Higher Guarantees, Jensen Huang's Exit Adds Uncertainty
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)長期執行長黃仁勳8月與全球六大資產管理公司共同推動規模達5000億美元的人工智慧(AI)融資平台，有知情人士透露，由於這幾個月未能促成任何交易，過去一個月以來已有部分客戶及華爾街合作夥伴，要求輝達提高融資擔保規模。
輝達8月表示，將提供所謂的「剩餘價值支持協議」(residual value support agreement)，承擔每筆交易最高25%的風險，比率低於競爭對手博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)提供的水準。部分知情人士指出，這項差距增加了促成交易的難度。
其中一人認為，輝達最快可能要到明年1月才能宣布任何交易，這還得建立在黃仁勳因婚外情傳聞戲劇化下台之際，不會有任何交易、甚至整個計畫因此生變的前提上。
響應的六大資產管理公司分別是阿波羅全球管理(Apollo Global Management)、貝萊德(BlackRock)(BLK-US)、黑石(Blackstone)(BX-US)、Brookfield Asset Management、高盛(GS-US)及KKR。

AI晶片融資市場快速擴張 「剩餘價值擔保」成關鍵

過去一年來，晶片債務融資市場規模迅速擴大。OpenAI、Anthropic 及SpaceX(SPCX-US)等大型業者，為了取得執行專門AI任務所需的昂貴處理器，正尋求各種融資管道，相關支出已超過數千億美元。
一般而言，企業會設立特殊目的公司(SPV)，透過發行債務籌措資金並持有晶片，再將晶片租賃給客戶。這些特殊目的公司的價值，來自客戶使用相關技術所簽訂合約產生的現金流，以及晶片本身的價值。
然而，貸款機構擔心持續燒錢的企業可能違約、不再支付租金，因此輝達與博通提供的剩餘價值擔保，對吸引貸款機構至關重要。
這類擔保的運作方式是：如果租賃付款中止，相關資產會重新出租或出售，用來償還剩餘債務。若所得金額仍不足以償還債務，則由提供擔保的一方補足差額。
這種機制不僅能吸引更多貸款機構參與交易，也有助於取得較高的信用評等，進而降低借貸成本。博通已開始透過今年6月與阿波羅及黑石成立的AI XPV合作平台，推動這類交易。

博通擔保比率達72.5% 輝達支持力度相形見絀

博通今年5月為一筆350億美元的債務交易提供300億美元擔保，該筆交易與Anthropic租用由博通及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google製造的TPU有關。博通提供擔保的債務部分取得投資等級評等，並享有較低利率。
另一筆規模630億美元的交易也意在支撐Anthropic。根據申報文件，博通將為其中72.5%的金額提供擔保，相當於約430億美元，這筆融資中，優先順位的第一順位擔保部分由美國銀行(BAC-US)、花旗集團(C-US)及摩根士丹利(MS-US)安排，至於第二順位融資中已承諾的部分，則由黑石單獨提供。還有一部分債務預定明年第1季出售給更廣泛的貸款機構。
如果輝達不願提高目前25%的剩餘價值擔保比例，可能使AI及雲端服務客戶更無力負擔採用輝達晶片的成本，也會降低貸款機構參與交易的意願。尤其當市場同時推出條件更優惠的類似交易時，輝達的方案將更難吸引資金。
對輝達而言，提高擔保比例也意味著必須承擔更高風險，並可能削弱原本希望透過第三方資金擴大融資平台、推動AI熱潮下一階段成長的目的。

黃仁勳離開後 誰能建立市場信心？

在黃仁勳下台後，輝達本身的前景正遭到質疑，因為過去30年來黃仁勳一直是這家公司的唯一執行長。
輝達周四宣布，財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)將接任臨時執行長，黃仁勳則將不再與這家公司有任何關聯。
在黃仁勳的領導下，輝達曾被稱為「AI的中央銀行」，透過在整個產業生態系中投資入股及提供融資擔保，替這個還在萌芽階段的產業建立信心。
今年8月宣布的融資計畫就是基於這個精神。當時，高盛、黑石及阿波羅花了好幾個月籌備債務交易，卻始終未能促成交易。黃仁勳仍公開讚揚這項規模5000億美元的計畫，表示這將替輝達的客戶提供融資，而這些客戶正是支撐輝達未來需求的關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) long‑time CEO Jensen Huang in August teamed up with six major global asset managers to push a $500 billion artificial‑intelligence (AI) financing platform. Insiders say that because no deals have been closed in recent months, some customers and Wall Street partners have, over the past month, asked Nvidia to increase the size of its financing guarantees.

In August Nvidia said it would offer a so‑called “residual‑value support agreement,” covering up to 25% of the risk on each transaction – a lower ratio than competitor Broadcom (AVGO-US) provides. Some insiders noted that this gap makes it harder to close deals.

One source believes Nvidia may not announce any transaction until as late as January next year, and that this assumes Jensen Huang’s dramatic exit amid extramarital‑affair rumors does not cause any deals—or the whole programme—to collapse.
The six responding asset managers are Apollo Global Management, BlackRock (BLK-US), Blackstone (BX-US), Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and KKR.

AI‑chip financing is expanding rapidly, with “residual‑value guarantees” becoming critical. Over the past year the chip‑debt market has grown quickly. Large players such as OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX (SPCX-US) are seeking financing to buy costly processors needed for dedicated AI workloads, with related spending now exceeding hundreds of billions of dollars.

Typically, companies set up special‑purpose vehicles (SPVs) that issue debt to raise cash, hold the chips, and then lease the chips to customers. The value of these SPVs comes from the cash flows generated by the customers’ technology‑use contracts and the chips themselves.
However, lenders worry that cash‑burning companies might default and stop paying lease fees, so the residual‑value guarantees offered by Nvidia and Broadcom are crucial for attracting lenders.

The guarantee works like this: if lease payments stop, the underlying assets are re‑leased or sold to repay the remaining debt. If the proceeds are still insufficient, the guarantor covers the shortfall.

This mechanism not only draws more lenders into the transaction but also helps achieve higher credit ratings, thereby lowering borrowing costs. Broadcom has already begun promoting such deals through the AI XPV platform it launched in June with Apollo and Blackstone.

Broadcom’s guarantee rate reaches 72.5%, dwarfing Nvidia’s support. In May Broadcom guaranteed $30 billion of a $35 billion debt deal tied to Anthropic’s lease of TPUs made by Broadcom and Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google, giving the debt an investment‑grade rating and a lower interest rate.

Another $63 billion transaction also aims to back Anthropic. According to filing documents, Broadcom will guarantee 72.5% of the amount – about $43 billion – with first‑lien guarantees arranged by Bank of America (BAC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US). The second‑lien portion already pledged is being provided solely by Blackstone, and part of the debt is slated for sale to a broader pool of lenders in Q1 2025.

If Nvidia refuses to raise its current 25% residual‑value guarantee, AI and cloud‑service customers may find it harder to afford Nvidia chips, and lenders may be less willing to participate. When the market offers similarly structured deals with more favorable terms, Nvidia’s offering will struggle to attract capital.

For Nvidia, raising the guarantee ratio also means taking on higher risk, potentially undermining the original goal of using third‑party capital to expand the financing platform and drive the next phase of AI‑driven growth.
Who can rebuild market confidence after Jensen Huang’s departure? After Huang steps down, Nvidia’s outlook is being questioned because he has been the company’s sole CEO for the past three decades.
Nvidia announced on Thursday that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO, and Jensen Huang will have no further ties to the company.
Under Huang’s leadership, Nvidia was dubbed the “central bank of AI,” investing in and providing financing guarantees across the industry ecosystem to build confidence in this still‑emerging sector.

The financing plan announced in August was based on that spirit. At the time, Goldman Sachs, Blackstone and Apollo spent months preparing a debt transaction but never succeeded in closing a deal. Huang publicly praised the $500 billion plan, saying it would finance Nvidia’s customers, who are the key to supporting Nvidia’s future demand.

items.title: 黃仁勳閃辭震撼輝達！傳數百員工聯名盼老闆回歸「他值得第二次機會」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Abrupt Resignation Shocks Nvidia; Hundreds of Employees Petition for His Return, Claim He Deserves a Second Chance
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 捲入婚外情與國安風波，週四 (12 日) 辭去執行長、總裁及董事職務，公司內部隨即傳出要求他回鍋的聲音。美國科技媒體《WIRED》報導，一篇在黃仁勳請辭前發布的內部意見箱貼文已累計逾 1,600 則留言，多數支持他繼續掌舵。另有數百名員工聯名請願，要求黃仁勳復職，並呼籲現任董事辭職下台。
員工聲援之際，輝達也面臨股價下跌與華府調查壓力。
《華爾街見聞》報導，自相關指控曝光以來，輝達市值一度蒸發逾 1 兆美元，美國國會議員和聯邦調查局 (FBI) 也相繼啟動調查。該報導另援引預測市場平台 Kalshi 的數據稱，約九成輝達員工希望黃仁勳留任，但未交代數據如何蒐集。
據《WIRED》查閱的內部通訊，輝達一名資深工程師在黃仁勳宣布請辭前，曾透過公司意見箱呼籲董事會在採取任何行動前，先徵詢員工對黃仁勳去留的看法，並公開調查結論。
這篇貼文後來也成為員工呼籲黃仁勳回歸的管道。
「如果你相信這家公司的使命，就把老闆請回來。」一名匿名員工在留言中寫道。另一人則表示，「我們都是人，都會犯錯。黃仁勳做了很多好事，他值得第二次機會。」
一名員工也寄信給全體員工，要求董事會更透明地交代黃仁勳離職的經過。「我支持黃仁勳，並不是因為我認為他不會犯錯，而是因為我不願相信，堅持公平就得與一位對我們如此重要的領導者劃清界線。」這名員工在信中寫道。
聲援也延伸到公開平台。
《WIRED》指出，黃仁勳辭職消息公布後數小時內，有 20 多名輝達員工在 LinkedIn 發文表達支持，其中一人表示，對黃仁勳領導能力的信心始終沒有動搖。
該媒體在同一時段搜尋，未發現輝達員工公開發文支持他離任。
一名在輝達任職數年、未獲公司授權公開發言的員工告訴《WIRED》，希望黃仁勳回歸的聲音在公司內部相當普遍。這名員工擔心，失去創辦人掌舵後，輝達可能逐步走下坡，並直言，「輝達之所以是今天的輝達，是因為黃仁勳。」
據報導，輝達本週營運照常，但董事會在內部調查尚未結束之際宣布黃仁勳請辭，令許多員工感到錯愕，也有人要求董事會說明為何在此時作出人事決定。
輝達已任命財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 兼任代理執行長，由哈維．瓊斯 (Harvey C. Jones) 出任董事長，董事會將從公司內外物色正式接班人。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang was embroiled in an extramarital affair and national security controversy, and on Thursday (12th) he resigned as CEO, president, and director, prompting immediate calls within the company for his return. U.S. tech media WIRED reported that an internal suggestion box post released before Huang’s resignation had accumulated over 1,600 comments, most of which supported him continuing to steer the company. Hundreds of employees also signed a petition demanding Huang’s reinstatement and calling for the resignation of current directors.
While employees rallied in support, Nvidia also faced falling stock prices and pressure from Washington investigations.

According to Wall Street Journal, since the allegations surfaced, Nvidia’s market value once evaporated more than $1 trillion, and U.S. Congress members and the FBI have both launched investigations. The report also cited data from market platform Kalshi, claiming that about ninety percent of Nvidia employees want Huang to stay, though it did not explain how the data were collected.

WIRED’s investigation of internal communications revealed that a senior engineer at Nvidia, before Huang announced his resignation, used the company suggestion box to urge the board to consult employees on Huang’s departure before taking any action and to publicly disclose the investigation’s findings.
That post later became a channel for employees to call for Huang’s return.

"If you believe in this company’s mission, bring the boss back," an anonymous employee wrote in a comment. Another said, "We’re all human and make mistakes. Huang has done many good things; he deserves a second chance."

An employee also sent a letter to all staff demanding the board be more transparent about the circumstances of Huang’s departure. "I support Huang, not because I think he won’t make mistakes, but because I refuse to believe that fairness requires drawing a line with a leader so vital to us," the employee wrote.
The support extended to public platforms.

WIRED noted that within hours of Huang’s resignation announcement, more than 20 Nvidia employees posted on LinkedIn expressing support, with one stating that his confidence in Huang’s leadership had never wavered.
During the same period, the media found no public posts from Nvidia employees supporting his departure.

A longtime Nvidia employee who was not authorized to speak publicly told WIRED that calls for Huang’s return were common within the company. The employee worried that without the founder at the helm, Nvidia might gradually decline, and bluntly said, "Nvidia is what it is today because of Huang."

Reports say Nvidia’s operations continued as usual this week, but the board announced Huang’s resignation while an internal investigation was still ongoing, leaving many employees shocked and some demanding an explanation for the timing of the personnel decision.
Nvidia has appointed CFO Colette Kress as acting CEO, with Harvey C. Jones as chairman, and the board will look for a permanent successor both inside and outside the company.

items.title: 「像床邊放了噴射發動機」 美居民強烈抗議AI資料中心噪音與廢氣侵擾
items.title_en: "Like a Jet Engine by the Bed" – U.S. Residents Vigorously Protest AI Data Center Noise and Emissions
paras: 11月12日，執掌公司33年的輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳宣布卸任執行長，為AI產業震撼投下變數。然而，對住在資料中心圍牆外的普通美國民眾而言，科技巨頭的更迭遠不及今晚能否安眠、下個月電費單多少來得切身。
隨著AI算力需求爆發，缺乏頂層規劃的美國資料中心加速深入住宅區，將原本安靜的社區推向抗爭前線。

噪音與廢氣進逼

在麻薩諸塞州洛厄爾(Lowell)，Markley Lowell資料中心由舊義大利麵工廠改建，因高聳黑影而被部分居民稱為「地牢」。82歲的退休居民Eileen Castle在此擁有祖厝，她無奈表示：「自從資料中心十年前搬進來，我們這裡除了噪音什麼都沒有，還有粉塵、污垢，以及冷卻塔飄出的各種水霧。」
她還擔憂，水霧可能散播退伍軍人症，廢氣與噪音更讓孫子女無法在游泳池游泳，房價隨之暴跌。
住家距離柴油發電機不到100英呎的居民Jake Fortes創立「Honest Future for Lowell」組織，直言：「我們被這家公司輾壓了，所以我們有些人開始出面抗爭。」他描述發電機測試時「就像有人在你床邊放了一台噴射發動機」。
38歲的實驗室技術員Luz Marte也指出，資料中心噪音大到「聽起來像飛機要起飛一樣」，保費暴漲三倍，讓她坦言：「這是我為兒子買的房子……現在我開始懷疑這個決定了。」
遠景集團AI資料中心業務總經理Ricky Zheng分析，美國因缺乏新增電力，大量資料中心多由現有廠房或比特幣礦場改造而成，周邊本就是住宅區；主要污染與噪音源自柴油發電機與氣渦輪機。

經濟效益與支持聲音

面對抗議，資料中心業者與支持者提出不同視角。Markley Group執行長Jeff Markley聲明指出，公司服務逾600家客戶，連接驅動經濟與學校的數位基礎設施。業者說明備用發電機每週僅測試5分鐘，音量降至「約44分貝，比3英呎外的輕聲細語還安靜」，且每年檢測水質兩次並已植樹2,000棵，聘用逾百名在地員工。
在地承包商Louis Haas感謝業者重整毒品氾濫的廢棄廠區，強調：「我是個大自由派、民主黨人，但我也支持就業和經濟。」43歲單親媽媽Sarah Bibeau也認同業者體貼，協助修路並提供免費賽事球票等福利。

法律抗爭與政治波瀾

儘管有支持聲，法律與政治抗爭已全面升溫。環保組織「環境法律基金會」(CLF)律師Adam Reynolds指出，在歷史工業區「污染的複合效應非常顯著」，已提告暫緩擴建。洛厄爾市議會已通過新建與擴建禁令；威廉王子郡居民亦透過訴訟推翻開發案。
民怨更延燒至政治。喬治·布希美中關係基金會總裁David Firestein指出，雖資料中心非期中選舉敗選唯一主因，但電費與噪音問題確實受政治敘事放大。德克薩斯州新當選州長Gina Hinojosa明確宣示：「我們會制定保護德州人的法律。在這些保護措施到位之前，我們需要暫停目前在資料中心上的做法。」
