paras_en: On November 12, Jensen Huang, the founder of Nvidia (NVDA-US) who has led the company for 33 years, announced his resignation as CEO, sending a shockwave through the AI industry. Yet for ordinary Americans living outside the fences of data centers, the turnover of a tech giant feels far less immediate than whether they can sleep tonight or how high next month’s electric bill will be.
As demand for AI computing power explodes, U.S. data centers—lacking top‑level planning—are racing into residential neighborhoods, turning once‑quiet communities into flashpoints of protest.

Noise and emissions encroach
In Lowell, Massachusetts, the Markley Lowell data center, converted from an old Italian pasta factory, looms like a “dungeon” to some residents. Eighty‑two‑year‑old retiree Eileen Castle, who owns a family home there, lamented, “Since the data center moved in ten years ago, all we have here is noise, plus dust, grime, and the mist that drifts out of the cooling towers.”
She also worries the mist could spread veteran‑related illnesses, while the fumes and noise prevent her grandchildren from swimming in the pool and have caused property values to plummet.

Resident Jake Fortes, who lives less than 100 feet from a diesel generator, founded the “Honest Future for Lowell” group and bluntly said, “We’re being trampled by this company, so some of us have started to fight back.” He described a generator test as “like someone putting a jet engine next to your bed.”

Thirty‑eight‑year‑old lab technician Luz Marte added that the data center’s noise is “like an airplane taking off,” insurance premiums have tripled, and she confessed, “This is the house I bought for my son… now I’m beginning to doubt that decision.”

Ricky Zheng, general manager of the AI data‑center business at Farview Group, explained that because the U.S. lacks new power capacity, many data centers are retrofits of existing factories or Bitcoin mines that were already in residential zones; the main pollutants and noise come from diesel generators and gas turbines.

Economic benefits and supportive voices
Facing the protests, the data‑center operator and its supporters offered a different perspective. Jeff Markley, CEO of Markley Group, said the company serves over 600 customers and powers the digital infrastructure of businesses and schools. The operator noted that backup generators are tested only five minutes per week, producing about 44 decibels—“quieter than a whisper three feet away”—and that water quality is tested twice a year, 2,000 trees have been planted, and more than a hundred local workers are employed.

Local contractor Louis Haas thanked the operator for revitalizing a drug‑riddled abandoned plant, emphasizing, “I’m a big liberal, a Democrat, but I also support jobs and the economy.” Forty‑three‑year‑old single mother Sarah Bibeau also praised the operator’s consideration, noting assistance with road repairs and free tickets to sporting events.

Legal battles and political turbulence
Despite supportive remarks, legal and political fights have heated up. Adam Reynolds, an attorney with the environmental group Climate Law Foundation (CLF), said the “cumulative pollution effects in historic industrial zones are very significant” and has filed a lawsuit to halt expansion. Lowell’s city council has passed a ban on new construction and expansions; residents of Prince William County have also sued to overturn a development plan.

Public anger is spilling into politics. David Firestein, president of the George Bush U.S.–China Relations Foundation, noted that while data centers are not the sole cause of the midterm election losses, electricity‑cost and noise issues are being amplified in political narratives. Newly elected Texas Governor Gina Hinojosa declared, “We will enact laws to protect Texans. Until those protections are in place, we need to pause current data‑center practices.”

Facing regulatory headwinds, Nebius senior vice president Ryan Hanrui Wang said tighter regulation will worsen delay issues, but major customers remain focused on data sovereignty and low latency (U.S. domestic latency).

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任傳聘頂尖律所 同時留下三大疑問
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Steps Down, Hires Top Law Firm, Leaving Three Major Questions
paras: 黃仁勳卸任輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長後，已聘請美國知名律師事務所 Paul Weiss，華爾街面臨三大疑問：誰能接掌輝達、AI 股會如何重新定價，以及黃仁勳下一步會去哪裡。花旗將輝達目標價從 285 美元降至 225 美元，伯恩斯坦更從 400 美元砍半至 200 美元。輝達週四 (12 日) 收跌 4.34%，同日超微與博通卻雙雙上漲逾 5%，AI 概念股走勢明顯分化。
誰能接掌輝達？
輝達目前由財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 暫代執行長，董事會將從公司內外物色正式接班人。
奧本海默分析師認為，黃仁勳留下的職位難以填補，公司目前也沒有明顯的接班人選，並警告部分輝達優秀員工可能隨他離開。
該券商已撤回輝達目標價。
花旗分析師馬利克 (Atif Malik) 與西拉 (Papa Sylla) 維持「買進」評級，但認為接班不確定性將持續壓抑股價。
兩人指出，黃仁勳的角色橫跨公司策略、產品方向及客戶關係，也是支撐投資人信心的關鍵人物。
Yorkville Ives 分析師艾夫斯 (Dan Ives) 則估計，黃仁勳掌舵時，輝達每股價值為 300 美元，卸任後降至 225 美元，相差 75 美元、約 25%。
輝達的人事變動將如何牽動 AI 股？
與輝達業務關係密切的 AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 週四收跌 6.86%，伺服器大廠美超微 (SMCI-US) 下跌 11.30%。超微 (AMD-US) 與博通 (AVGO-US) 則分別上漲 5.86% 與 5.54%。
《巴隆周刊》指出，這樣的分化顯示，投資人仍可能透過其他晶片股參與 AI 投資熱潮。
William Blair 分析師納吉 (Sebastien Naji) 與畢爾包 (Ana Bilbao) 認為，輝達除了面對領導層空窗與政府審查可能升高的風險，原本就面臨替代晶片競爭升溫。
伯恩斯坦分析師則認為，相關事件的全貌可能尚未浮現，因而大幅下修目標價。
黃仁勳本人下一步會去哪裡？
馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 曾以玩笑口吻表示，若能聘請黃仁勳將是「一種榮幸」。
黃仁勳尚未公布下一步職涯安排。
《紐約時報》引述知情人士報導，他已聘請美國知名律所 Paul Weiss，並由該所訴訟律師梅琳達・哈格 (Melinda Haag) 與華特・布朗 (Walter Brown) 提供法律協助。
輝達董事會先前則宣布，再度委託律所 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 主導內部調查，釐清黃仁勳與商界人士黃樂 (Alice Huang) 的關係。
隨著董事會展開接班人搜尋，投資人將關注克雷斯能否穩住核心團隊與客戶關係，並讓既定產品如期交付。
paras_en: After Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), he hired the renowned U.S. law firm Paul Weiss, prompting Wall Street to face three big questions: who will take over Nvidia, how AI stocks will be re‑priced, and where Huang will go next. Citi cut Nvidia's price target from $285 to $225, and Bernstein slashed its target from $400 to $200. Nvidia fell 4.34% on Thursday the 12th, while AMD and Broadcom each rose more than 5%, showing a clear split among AI‑related shares.
Who can take over Nvidia?
Nvidia is currently being run on an interim basis by CFO Colette Kress, while the board looks inside and outside the company for a permanent successor.
Oppenheimer analysts say the role Jensen Huang left is hard to fill, that there is no clear successor at the moment, and they warn that some of Nvidia's top talent could leave with him.
The brokerage has withdrawn its Nvidia price target.
Citi analysts Atif Malik and Papa Sylla keep a "Buy" rating but say the succession uncertainty will continue to weigh on the stock.
They note that Huang's role spanned corporate strategy, product direction and customer relationships, making him a key source of investor confidence.
Yorkville Ives analyst Dan Ives estimates that Nvidia was worth $300 per share under Huang and that the value fell to $225 after his departure, a drop of $75 or about 25%.
How will Nvidia's personnel changes affect AI stocks?
AI‑cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) fell 6.86% on Thursday, server maker Super Micro (SMCI-US) dropped 11.30%, while AMD (AMD-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) rose 5.86% and 5.54% respectively.
Barron's noted that this divergence shows investors may still seek AI exposure through other chip stocks.
William Blair analysts Sebastien Naji and Ana Bilbao say Nvidia now faces a leadership vacuum, heightened regulatory scrutiny and already‑warming competition from alternative chips.
Bernstein analysts argue that the full impact of the events may not yet be visible, which is why they cut the price target sharply.
Where will Jensen Huang go next?
Elon Musk has joked that hiring Jensen Huang would be "an honor" if the opportunity arose.
Huang has not yet disclosed his next career move.
The New York Times, citing sources, reported that he has hired the prominent law firm Paul Weiss, with litigation partners Melinda Haag and Walter Brown providing legal assistance.
Nvidia's board previously announced that it has re‑engaged the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to lead an internal investigation into Huang's relationship with business figure Alice Huang.
As the board searches for a successor, investors will watch whether Kress can keep the core team and customer relationships stable and ensure that existing product rollouts stay on schedule.

items.title: 艾克曼稱Anthropic「本世紀最驚人商業故事」卻不打算買進
items.title_en: Ackman Calls Anthropic ‘Century’s Most Amazing Business Story’ but Won’t Buy In
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，Pershing Square Capital Management執行長艾克曼(Bill Ackman)認為，Anthropic是一家極具潛力的企業，也是一個非常出色的商業故事。不過，等到Anthropic正式上市交易後，別指望他會在初期就進場。
這位知名價值型投資人在Yahoo Finance Invest活動上表示，「我們一向將自己定位為風險承受度非常低的投資人。我們希望投資的是能夠以極高信心程度預測其表現的企業。」
他談到，「我認為，就一家從零開始一路發展到今天規模的企業而言，Anthropic或許是本世紀最驚人的商業故事。這是一段極不尋常、令人難以置信的成長歷程，也是一個非常令人印象深刻的故事。但要判斷這家企業究竟值多少錢，問題就複雜得多。要精準估算其價值非常困難，因為有幾項難以預測的變數，可能讓它的價值大幅提高，也可能大幅降低。這也是為什麼它不符合我們投資組合的配置條件。」
Anthropic已將IPO每股價格區間訂在70至78美元，目標完全稀釋後估值約1.4兆美元。若以價格區間上限計算，這次IPO募資金額最高可能達到1,000億美元。
然而，若要讓公開市場接受如此高昂的估值，Anthropic仍有許多需要證明的地方。
根據Anthropic提交的修訂版S-1上市申請文件，公司第三季銷售額年增1,127%，達到170億美元。不過，營收成長速度以季對季來看已經放緩。第三季銷售額成長47%，低於第二季的144%，第一季則成長132%。
此外，Anthropic第三季更出現高達232.9億美元的虧損。
Anthropic預計11月19日在公開市場掛牌交易，並計劃在那斯達克上市，股票代號為ANT。

艾克曼補充道，「我認為Anthropic正處於營運獲利能力即將成形，甚至可能已經達到真正具備營運獲利能力的階段。但問題在於，如果Anthropic無法維持領先地位，外界就會開始真正質疑它的商業模式。因此，公司必須投入的資本支出確實相當龐大……我想說的是，這是一個相當複雜的問題，未來結果的可能範圍也更廣，投資Anthropic是一項投機性更高的押注。相較之下，買進我們持有的Visa這類公司，風險就沒有那麼高。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Bill Ackman, CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, sees Anthropic as a highly promising company and an outstanding business story. However, once Anthropic goes public, don’t expect him to jump in during the early trading period.

The well‑known value investor said at a Yahoo Finance Invest event, “We always position ourselves as investors with a very low risk tolerance. We want to invest in companies whose performance we can predict with extremely high confidence.”

He added, “I think Anthropic may be the most astonishing business story of the century for a company that started from zero and grew to its current scale. It’s an unusually remarkable and incredible growth trajectory, a very impressive story. But determining how much the company is worth is far more complex. Accurately estimating its value is very difficult because several unpredictable variables could either dramatically increase or dramatically decrease its worth. That’s why it doesn’t fit the allocation criteria of our portfolio.”
Anthropic has set its IPO price range at $70‑$78 per share, implying a fully diluted valuation of about $1.4 trillion. At the top of the range, the IPO could raise as much as $100 billion.
However, for the public market to accept such a lofty valuation, Anthropic still has many hurdles to prove.

According to the revised S‑1 filing, the company’s third‑quarter sales grew 1,127% year‑over‑year to $17 billion, though the quarter‑over‑quarter growth rate has slowed. Q3 sales rose 47% versus 144% in Q2 and 132% in Q1.
In addition, Anthropic posted a loss of $23.29 billion in the third quarter.
Anthropic plans to list on the Nasdaq under the ticker “ANT” on November 19.

Ackman added, “I think Anthropic is at the point where operational profitability is about to materialize, perhaps already achieved. The issue is that if Anthropic can’t maintain its leadership, the market will seriously question its business model. The capital expenditures the company must make are indeed massive… What I’m saying is this is a very complex issue, the range of possible outcomes is broader, and investing in Anthropic is a more speculative bet. By contrast, buying a company like Visa that we already hold carries far less risk.”

items.title: 黃仁勳請辭波及記憶體股 美光、SK海力士走低 分析師示警先進記憶體需求
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns, Dragging Down Memory Stocks; Micron, SK Hynix Fall as Analysts Warn of Advanced Memory Demand
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 請辭執行長，賣壓週四 (12 日) 從輝達擴散至人工智慧 (AI) 供應鏈。輝達下跌 4.34%，美光 (MU-US) 跌 1.59%，SK 海力士下跌 3.19%，SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下挫 4.11%。盛寶銀行首席投資策略師 Charu Chanana 指出，若輝達產品推出時程延後，市場可能下修對先進記憶體的短期需求預期。
美光透過直接與間接管道向輝達供應晶片，營收因此也受到輝達新品出貨節奏影響。
若新一代 AI 加速器延後推出或量產，原本預期隨之放量的高效能記憶體出貨也可能遞延，進而影響美光近期銷售。
美光股價今年稍早已受記憶體供過於求的疑慮拖累，目前約 787 美元，較 6 月高點 1,211 美元低約 35%。
這波賣壓也波及 AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 與資料中心電力設備供應商 Bloom Energy (BE-US)。Chanana 表示，輝達的人事風波凸顯投資人先前可能低估的領導與公司治理風險。
市場原本就對 AI 支出規模、舉債融資及投資回報有所疑慮，若接班與營運前景的不確定性持續，整個 AI 類股的估值都可能進一步承壓。
美光近期在提交給美國主管機關的文件中指出，沒有任何單一客戶占其總營收逾 10%。
Chanana 也指出，其他 AI 加速器平台同樣需要高效能記憶體，超微 (AMD-US) 與博通 (AVGO-US) 等業者可為記憶體供應商帶來其他需求。超微週四逆勢上漲 5.86%。
對記憶體廠而言，短期營收仍取決於各平台的量產時程，以及其他客戶的出貨增量能否填補輝達新品若延後所留下的缺口。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO, and the sell‑off on Thursday the 12th spread from Nvidia to the artificial‑intelligence (AI) supply chain. Nvidia fell 4.34%, Micron (MU‑US) dropped 1.59%, SK Hynix slipped 3.19% and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) slid 4.11%. HSBC chief investment strategist Charu Chanana noted that if Nvidia’s product rollout is delayed, the market may downgrade short‑term demand expectations for advanced memory.
Micron supplies chips to Nvidia through both direct and indirect channels, so its revenue is also affected by the pace of Nvidia’s new‑product shipments.

If the next‑generation AI accelerator is delayed in launch or mass production, the high‑performance memory shipments that were expected to scale up could also be postponed, further impacting Micron’s near‑term sales.
Micron’s share price has already been weighed down this year by concerns of excess memory supply, trading around $787, about 35% below its June peak of $1,211.

The sell‑off also hit AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and data‑center power‑equipment supplier Bloom Energy (BE‑US). Chanana said Nvidia’s leadership turmoil highlights governance and leadership risks that investors may have previously underestimated.

The market was already uneasy about the scale of AI spending, debt financing and investment returns, and if uncertainty around the succession and operating outlook persists, valuations across AI‑related stocks could face further pressure.
Micron recently disclosed in a filing to U.S. regulators that no single customer accounts for more than 10% of its total revenue.

Chanana also pointed out that other AI accelerator platforms also need high‑performance memory, and companies such as AMD (AMD‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) could provide additional demand for memory suppliers. AMD rose 5.86% on Thursday despite the broader weakness.

For memory makers, short‑term revenue still depends on the mass‑production timelines of each platform and whether incremental shipments from other customers can fill the gap left by any delay in Nvidia’s new products.

items.title: 跌時加碼！輝達開盤暴跌逾14% 散戶半小時買盤超正常40倍　單日淨買入破1.1億美元創九年新高
items.title_en: Buy the Dip! Nvidia Plunges Over 14% at Open, Retail Investors Buy 40 Times Normal in Half an Hour, Net Daily Purchase Exceeds $110 Million, a Nine-Year High
paras: 輝達創辦人黃仁勳週四(12日)無預警卸任並退出董事會，股價劇震，開盤一度暴跌逾14%，終場收跌4.3%，單日市值蒸發約1820億美元，但在市場恐慌之際，散戶卻掀起創紀錄的抄底潮。
《金融時報》報導，根據Vanda Research數據，輝達週四開盤僅半小時便錄得1.11億美元散戶淨買超，超過正常水準40倍，刷新2017年以來紀錄。該股在週一(9日)至週三(11日)均居散戶淨買超榜首，吸金約13.1億美元。
另據富達數據，截至美股週四午盤，客戶買單近39.5萬筆，遠超8萬筆賣單，做多熱情亦蔓延至槓桿ETF。
相較之下，華爾街轉趨審慎。自那斯達克五週前觸頂以來，輝達累計下跌近三分之一，市值縮水逾1兆美元。Baird分析師將其評級降至「中立」，目標價大砍60%至200美元，主要因為供應掣肘與需求隱憂恐削弱2027年資料中心業務能見度。
此次震盪源於黃仁勳近期爆發的婚外情醜聞與治理問題。掌舵輝達33年的他週四離職，由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)出任臨時執行長，公司正物色繼任者。
不過，惠靈頓資產管理公司與Blue Whale基金等機構認為，輝達未來兩三年產品路線已定，短期換帥難改基本面。市場焦點轉向下週發布的財報，新管理層對AI前景的闡述將是檢驗信心關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang unexpectedly stepped down and left the board on Thursday (the 12th), sending the stock into a frenzy; it briefly tumbled more than 14% at the open and closed down 4.3%, wiping about $182 billion off its market value in a single day, yet amid the panic retail investors launched a record‑breaking buying spree.

The Financial Times reported that, according to Vanda Research data, Nvidia recorded a net retail buy of $111 million within just half an hour of Thursday’s open – more than 40 times the normal level and the strongest since 2017. The stock topped the retail net‑buy list from Monday (the 9th) through Wednesday (the 11th), pulling in roughly $1.31 billion.

Fidelity data showed that by the U.S. market’s midday on Thursday, customers had placed about 395,000 buy orders versus just over 80,000 sell orders, and the buying enthusiasm also spread to leveraged ETFs.

In contrast, Wall Street grew more cautious. Since the Nasdaq peak five weeks ago, Nvidia has fallen nearly one‑third, erasing over $1 trillion in market cap. Baird analysts cut the rating to "Neutral" and slashed the price target by 60% to $200, citing supply constraints and demand uncertainties that could dim the outlook for its 2027 data‑center business.

The turmoil stems from a recent extramarital affair scandal involving Jensen Huang and governance concerns. After steering Nvidia for 33 years, he left on Thursday, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO while the company searches for a permanent successor.

However, Wellington Management and the Blue Whale fund argue that Nvidia’s product roadmap is set for the next two‑to‑three years, and a short‑term leadership change won’t alter the fundamentals. Market attention now shifts to next week’s earnings release, where the new management’s view on AI will be the key test of confidence.

items.title: 民主黨展開輝達調查：質疑黃仁勳與川普的晶片交易與2600萬美元政治捐款
items.title_en: Democrats Launch Nvidia Probe, Questioning Jensen Huang’s Chip Deal with Trump and $26 Million Political Donation
paras: 美國國會民主黨高層周四(12日)針對川普政府處理輝達(NVDA-US)對中國晶片銷售案正式展開調查。眾議院歲入委員會資深民主黨議員尼爾(Richard Neal)與參議院財政委員會資深民主黨議員懷登(Ron Wyden)聯名致函美國商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)，要求商務部妥善保存與此晶片交易相關的所有記錄與文件。
此項調查啟動之際，輝達前執行長黃仁勳才剛因承認與婚外情而辭職下台。
在致盧特尼克的公開信中，尼爾與懷登詳細拆解了川普政府與輝達之間的交易模式：川普同意向中國出售輝達的 H200 與 H20 AI 晶片，但要求這些在台灣製造的晶片必須先運抵美國。晶片抵達美國後，川普政府隨即對其徵收關稅，形同抽成輝達與AMD(AMD-US)對中銷售額的 15% 至 25%，隨後商務部才核發出口許可證。
尼爾與懷登在信中指出：「計畫的運作方式如此……表面上看似建立了一套違憲的出口稅制度。」
兩位議員嚴厲批評川普引用 1962 年《貿易擴張法》第 232 條授權的作法，並在信中引述發言表示：「國會制定第 232 條是為了給予總統工具，針對其認定構成國家安全威脅的進口商品採取行動；川普對此法條的使用似乎恰恰相反，損害了美國的國家安全，並使美國人面臨風險。」
信中進一步強調：「川普政府表面上企圖將違憲的出口稅偽裝成國家安全關稅行動——同時使輝達和中國政府受益——這在我們委員會關於稅收和關稅的事務管轄範圍內引發了嚴重疑慮。」
除了出口機制外，民主黨調查同時指向商務部在國安審查上的重大漏洞。輝達在新加坡的客戶 Megaspeed 被美國官方懷疑協助將先進 AI 晶片轉運至中國，而此公司高層黃樂不僅被疑為中國情報人員，更與黃仁勳爆出婚外情關係。
信中質問商務部為何在情報部門提出警示後，仍持續批准 Megaspeed 購買晶片，甚至傳出商務部在輝達接觸後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查。對此，尼爾與懷登在信中明確抨擊：「商務部在批准這些輝達晶片的中資買家過程中，顯然嚴重缺乏盡職調查——鑑於有報導稱商務部在輝達外聯後暫停了對 Megaspeed 的獨立調查，這一點尤為令人擔憂。」
此外，調查信函還質疑輝達向川普相關計畫捐贈 2,600 萬美元(包含白宮宴會廳建設)與交易案的關聯。議員指出，出口協議是在川普得知黃仁勳「處於被妥協的處境」及收到捐款後獲得批准，質疑川普是否利用其掌握婚外情的秘密來施壓索取政治捐款。
共和黨主導的國會小組(包含眾議院中共特別委員會、外交委員會與情報委員會)先前已要求黃仁勳出席閉門聽證會，黃仁勳已在周四辭職後同意作證。
川普日前在《60分鐘》專訪中曾提及，其團隊曾以入獄威脅一名未具名的 AI 高層，隨後這名高層「徹底改變」。截至目前，白宮與美國商務部尚未對民主黨議員的調查信函做出公開回應。
paras_en: U.S. House Democratic leaders on Thursday (the 12th) formally opened an investigation into the Trump administration’s handling of Nvidia (NVDA-US) chip sales to China. Senior Democratic members of the House Ways and Means Committee, Richard Neal, and the Senate Finance Committee, Ron Wyden, jointly wrote to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, demanding that the Commerce Department preserve all records and documents related to the chip transaction.
The probe was launched just as former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down after admitting to an extramarital affair.

In their public letter to Lutnick, Neal and Wyden dissected the transaction model between the Trump administration and Nvidia: Trump agreed to allow Nvidia’s H200 and H20 AI chips—manufactured in Taiwan—to be shipped to the United States before being sent to China. Once the chips arrived in the U.S., the administration immediately imposed tariffs, effectively taking 15% to 25% of Nvidia’s and AMD’s (AMD-US) sales to China, after which the Commerce Department issued export licenses.
Neal and Wyden wrote in the letter, "The plan operates in this way… on its face it appears to create an unconstitutional export tax regime."

The two lawmakers harshly criticized Trump’s reliance on the 1962 Trade Expansion Act’s Section 232 authority, quoting his remarks: "Section 232 was enacted by Congress to give the President a tool to act against imports deemed a national‑security threat; Trump’s use of the provision seems to do the opposite, harming U.S. security and putting Americans at risk."

The letter further emphasized, "The Trump administration’s attempt to disguise an unconstitutional export tax as a national‑security tariff—while benefiting Nvidia and the Chinese government—raises serious concerns within our committee’s jurisdiction over tax and tariff matters."

Beyond the export mechanism, the Democratic inquiry also points to a major flaw in the Commerce Department’s national‑security review. Nvidia’s Singapore customer Megaspeed is suspected by U.S. officials of funneling advanced AI chips to China, and its executive Huang Le is alleged to be a Chinese intelligence operative and linked to Jensen Huang’s affair.

The letter asks why the Commerce Department continued to approve Megaspeed’s chip purchases after intelligence agencies raised warnings, and even reportedly halted its independent investigation of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s involvement. Neal and Wyden state, "The Commerce Department clearly lacked due diligence in approving these Chinese‑linked buyers of Nvidia chips—especially concerning reports that it paused its independent probe of Megaspeed after Nvidia’s outreach, which is deeply troubling."

The investigators also question the $26 million donation that Nvidia made to Trump‑related projects (including the White House’s banquet hall construction) and its connection to the deal. Lawmakers note the export agreement was approved after Trump learned that Jensen Huang was "in a compromised position" and had received the donation, suggesting Trump may have leveraged the affair’s secrecy to extract political contributions.

A Republican‑led congressional panel (including the House China‑related Special Committee, the Foreign Affairs Committee and the Intelligence Committee) had previously subpoenaed Huang for a closed‑door hearing; Huang agreed to testify after resigning on Thursday.

Trump recently told "60 Minutes" that his team once threatened to imprison an unnamed AI executive, after which the executive "completely changed"; to date, neither the White House nor the Commerce Department has publicly responded to the Democrats’ investigative letter.

items.title: 輝達5000億美元AI融資計畫傳數月掛蛋！ 客戶要求提高擔保 黃仁勳離開後前景添變數
items.title_en: Nvidia's $500 Billion AI Financing Plan Said to Be Stalled for Months! Customers Demand Higher Guarantees, Jensen Huang's Exit Adds Uncertainty
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)長期執行長黃仁勳8月與全球六大資產管理公司共同推動規模達5000億美元的人工智慧(AI)融資平台，有知情人士透露，由於這幾個月未能促成任何交易，過去一個月以來已有部分客戶及華爾街合作夥伴，要求輝達提高融資擔保規模。
輝達8月表示，將提供所謂的「剩餘價值支持協議」(residual value support agreement)，承擔每筆交易最高25%的風險，比率低於競爭對手博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)提供的水準。部分知情人士指出，這項差距增加了促成交易的難度。
其中一人認為，輝達最快可能要到明年1月才能宣布任何交易，這還得建立在黃仁勳因婚外情傳聞戲劇化下台之際，不會有任何交易、甚至整個計畫因此生變的前提上。
響應的六大資產管理公司分別是阿波羅全球管理(Apollo Global Management)、貝萊德(BlackRock)(BLK-US)、黑石(Blackstone)(BX-US)、Brookfield Asset Management、高盛(GS-US)及KKR。

AI晶片融資市場快速擴張 「剩餘價值擔保」成關鍵

過去一年來，晶片債務融資市場規模迅速擴大。OpenAI、Anthropic 及SpaceX(SPCX-US)等大型業者，為了取得執行專門AI任務所需的昂貴處理器，正尋求各種融資管道，相關支出已超過數千億美元。
一般而言，企業會設立特殊目的公司(SPV)，透過發行債務籌措資金並持有晶片，再將晶片租賃給客戶。這些特殊目的公司的價值，來自客戶使用相關技術所簽訂合約產生的現金流，以及晶片本身的價值。
然而，貸款機構擔心持續燒錢的企業可能違約、不再支付租金，因此輝達與博通提供的剩餘價值擔保，對吸引貸款機構至關重要。
這類擔保的運作方式是：如果租賃付款中止，相關資產會重新出租或出售，用來償還剩餘債務。若所得金額仍不足以償還債務，則由提供擔保的一方補足差額。
這種機制不僅能吸引更多貸款機構參與交易，也有助於取得較高的信用評等，進而降低借貸成本。博通已開始透過今年6月與阿波羅及黑石成立的AI XPV合作平台，推動這類交易。

博通擔保比率達72.5% 輝達支持力度相形見絀

博通今年5月為一筆350億美元的債務交易提供300億美元擔保，該筆交易與Anthropic租用由博通及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google製造的TPU有關。博通提供擔保的債務部分取得投資等級評等，並享有較低利率。
另一筆規模630億美元的交易也意在支撐Anthropic。根據申報文件，博通將為其中72.5%的金額提供擔保，相當於約430億美元，這筆融資中，優先順位的第一順位擔保部分由美國銀行(BAC-US)、花旗集團(C-US)及摩根士丹利(MS-US)安排，至於第二順位融資中已承諾的部分，則由黑石單獨提供。還有一部分債務預定明年第1季出售給更廣泛的貸款機構。
如果輝達不願提高目前25%的剩餘價值擔保比例，可能使AI及雲端服務客戶更無力負擔採用輝達晶片的成本，也會降低貸款機構參與交易的意願。尤其當市場同時推出條件更優惠的類似交易時，輝達的方案將更難吸引資金。
對輝達而言，提高擔保比例也意味著必須承擔更高風險，並可能削弱原本希望透過第三方資金擴大融資平台、推動AI熱潮下一階段成長的目的。

黃仁勳離開後 誰能建立市場信心？

在黃仁勳下台後，輝達本身的前景正遭到質疑，因為過去30年來黃仁勳一直是這家公司的唯一執行長。
輝達周四宣布，財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)將接任臨時執行長，黃仁勳則將不再與這家公司有任何關聯。
在黃仁勳的領導下，輝達曾被稱為「AI的中央銀行」，透過在整個產業生態系中投資入股及提供融資擔保，替這個還在萌芽階段的產業建立信心。
今年8月宣布的融資計畫就是基於這個精神。當時，高盛、黑石及阿波羅花了好幾個月籌備債務交易，卻始終未能促成交易。黃仁勳仍公開讚揚這項規模5000億美元的計畫，表示這將替輝達的客戶提供融資，而這些客戶正是支撐輝達未來需求的關鍵。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) long‑time CEO Jensen Huang in August teamed up with six major global asset managers to push a $500 billion artificial‑intelligence (AI) financing platform. Insiders say that because no deals have been closed in recent months, some customers and Wall Street partners have, over the past month, asked Nvidia to increase the size of its financing guarantees.

In August Nvidia said it would offer a so‑called “residual‑value support agreement,” covering up to 25% of the risk on each transaction – a lower ratio than competitor Broadcom (AVGO-US) provides. Some insiders noted that this gap makes it harder to close deals.

One source believes Nvidia may not announce any transaction until as late as January next year, and that this assumes Jensen Huang’s dramatic exit amid extramarital‑affair rumors does not cause any deals—or the whole programme—to collapse.
The six responding asset managers are Apollo Global Management, BlackRock (BLK-US), Blackstone (BX-US), Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs (GS-US) and KKR.

AI‑chip financing is expanding rapidly, with “residual‑value guarantees” becoming critical. Over the past year the chip‑debt market has grown quickly. Large players such as OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX (SPCX-US) are seeking financing to buy costly processors needed for dedicated AI workloads, with related spending now exceeding hundreds of billions of dollars.

Typically, companies set up special‑purpose vehicles (SPVs) that issue debt to raise cash, hold the chips, and then lease the chips to customers. The value of these SPVs comes from the cash flows generated by the customers’ technology‑use contracts and the chips themselves.
However, lenders worry that cash‑burning companies might default and stop paying lease fees, so the residual‑value guarantees offered by Nvidia and Broadcom are crucial for attracting lenders.

The guarantee works like this: if lease payments stop, the underlying assets are re‑leased or sold to repay the remaining debt. If the proceeds are still insufficient, the guarantor covers the shortfall.

This mechanism not only draws more lenders into the transaction but also helps achieve higher credit ratings, thereby lowering borrowing costs. Broadcom has already begun promoting such deals through the AI XPV platform it launched in June with Apollo and Blackstone.

Broadcom’s guarantee rate reaches 72.5%, dwarfing Nvidia’s support. In May Broadcom guaranteed $30 billion of a $35 billion debt deal tied to Anthropic’s lease of TPUs made by Broadcom and Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google, giving the debt an investment‑grade rating and a lower interest rate.

Another $63 billion transaction also aims to back Anthropic. According to filing documents, Broadcom will guarantee 72.5% of the amount – about $43 billion – with first‑lien guarantees arranged by Bank of America (BAC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US). The second‑lien portion already pledged is being provided solely by Blackstone, and part of the debt is slated for sale to a broader pool of lenders in Q1 2025.

If Nvidia refuses to raise its current 25% residual‑value guarantee, AI and cloud‑service customers may find it harder to afford Nvidia chips, and lenders may be less willing to participate. When the market offers similarly structured deals with more favorable terms, Nvidia’s offering will struggle to attract capital.

For Nvidia, raising the guarantee ratio also means taking on higher risk, potentially undermining the original goal of using third‑party capital to expand the financing platform and drive the next phase of AI‑driven growth.
Who can rebuild market confidence after Jensen Huang’s departure? After Huang steps down, Nvidia’s outlook is being questioned because he has been the company’s sole CEO for the past three decades.
Nvidia announced on Thursday that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO, and Jensen Huang will have no further ties to the company.
Under Huang’s leadership, Nvidia was dubbed the “central bank of AI,” investing in and providing financing guarantees across the industry ecosystem to build confidence in this still‑emerging sector.

The financing plan announced in August was based on that spirit. At the time, Goldman Sachs, Blackstone and Apollo spent months preparing a debt transaction but never succeeded in closing a deal. Huang publicly praised the $500 billion plan, saying it would finance Nvidia’s customers, who are the key to supporting Nvidia’s future demand.

items.title: 黃仁勳閃辭震撼輝達！傳數百員工聯名盼老闆回歸「他值得第二次機會」
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Abrupt Resignation Shocks Nvidia; Hundreds of Employees Petition for His Return, Claim He Deserves a Second Chance
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 創辦人黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 捲入婚外情與國安風波，週四 (12 日) 辭去執行長、總裁及董事職務，公司內部隨即傳出要求他回鍋的聲音。美國科技媒體《WIRED》報導，一篇在黃仁勳請辭前發布的內部意見箱貼文已累計逾 1,600 則留言，多數支持他繼續掌舵。另有數百名員工聯名請願，要求黃仁勳復職，並呼籲現任董事辭職下台。
員工聲援之際，輝達也面臨股價下跌與華府調查壓力。
《華爾街見聞》報導，自相關指控曝光以來，輝達市值一度蒸發逾 1 兆美元，美國國會議員和聯邦調查局 (FBI) 也相繼啟動調查。該報導另援引預測市場平台 Kalshi 的數據稱，約九成輝達員工希望黃仁勳留任，但未交代數據如何蒐集。
據《WIRED》查閱的內部通訊，輝達一名資深工程師在黃仁勳宣布請辭前，曾透過公司意見箱呼籲董事會在採取任何行動前，先徵詢員工對黃仁勳去留的看法，並公開調查結論。
這篇貼文後來也成為員工呼籲黃仁勳回歸的管道。
「如果你相信這家公司的使命，就把老闆請回來。」一名匿名員工在留言中寫道。另一人則表示，「我們都是人，都會犯錯。黃仁勳做了很多好事，他值得第二次機會。」
一名員工也寄信給全體員工，要求董事會更透明地交代黃仁勳離職的經過。「我支持黃仁勳，並不是因為我認為他不會犯錯，而是因為我不願相信，堅持公平就得與一位對我們如此重要的領導者劃清界線。」這名員工在信中寫道。
聲援也延伸到公開平台。
《WIRED》指出，黃仁勳辭職消息公布後數小時內，有 20 多名輝達員工在 LinkedIn 發文表達支持，其中一人表示，對黃仁勳領導能力的信心始終沒有動搖。
該媒體在同一時段搜尋，未發現輝達員工公開發文支持他離任。
一名在輝達任職數年、未獲公司授權公開發言的員工告訴《WIRED》，希望黃仁勳回歸的聲音在公司內部相當普遍。這名員工擔心，失去創辦人掌舵後，輝達可能逐步走下坡，並直言，「輝達之所以是今天的輝達，是因為黃仁勳。」
據報導，輝達本週營運照常，但董事會在內部調查尚未結束之際宣布黃仁勳請辭，令許多員工感到錯愕，也有人要求董事會說明為何在此時作出人事決定。
輝達已任命財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 兼任代理執行長，由哈維．瓊斯 (Harvey C. Jones) 出任董事長，董事會將從公司內外物色正式接班人。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang was embroiled in an extramarital affair and national security controversy, and on Thursday (12th) he resigned as CEO, president, and director, prompting immediate calls within the company for his return. U.S. tech media WIRED reported that an internal suggestion box post released before Huang’s resignation had accumulated over 1,600 comments, most of which supported him continuing to steer the company. Hundreds of employees also signed a petition demanding Huang’s reinstatement and calling for the resignation of current directors.
While employees rallied in support, Nvidia also faced falling stock prices and pressure from Washington investigations.

According to Wall Street Journal, since the allegations surfaced, Nvidia’s market value once evaporated more than $1 trillion, and U.S. Congress members and the FBI have both launched investigations. The report also cited data from market platform Kalshi, claiming that about ninety percent of Nvidia employees want Huang to stay, though it did not explain how the data were collected.

WIRED’s investigation of internal communications revealed that a senior engineer at Nvidia, before Huang announced his resignation, used the company suggestion box to urge the board to consult employees on Huang’s departure before taking any action and to publicly disclose the investigation’s findings.
That post later became a channel for employees to call for Huang’s return.

"If you believe in this company’s mission, bring the boss back," an anonymous employee wrote in a comment. Another said, "We’re all human and make mistakes. Huang has done many good things; he deserves a second chance."

An employee also sent a letter to all staff demanding the board be more transparent about the circumstances of Huang’s departure. "I support Huang, not because I think he won’t make mistakes, but because I refuse to believe that fairness requires drawing a line with a leader so vital to us," the employee wrote.
The support extended to public platforms.

WIRED noted that within hours of Huang’s resignation announcement, more than 20 Nvidia employees posted on LinkedIn expressing support, with one stating that his confidence in Huang’s leadership had never wavered.
During the same period, the media found no public posts from Nvidia employees supporting his departure.

A longtime Nvidia employee who was not authorized to speak publicly told WIRED that calls for Huang’s return were common within the company. The employee worried that without the founder at the helm, Nvidia might gradually decline, and bluntly said, "Nvidia is what it is today because of Huang."

Reports say Nvidia’s operations continued as usual this week, but the board announced Huang’s resignation while an internal investigation was still ongoing, leaving many employees shocked and some demanding an explanation for the timing of the personnel decision.
Nvidia has appointed CFO Colette Kress as acting CEO, with Harvey C. Jones as chairman, and the board will look for a permanent successor both inside and outside the company.

items.title: 白銀跌深是重大利多？高盛：尚未確認觸底 三大信號顯示多空力量正重新平衡
items.title_en: Is Silver's Deep Decline a Major Bullish Signal? Goldman Sachs: Bottom Not Yet Confirmed, Three Signals Show Bull‑Bear Balance Reset
paras: 白銀市場交易邏輯正在變化。經歷數週拋售後，投機淨多頭部位降至近兩年極低水平，白銀面對利空消息的反應也轉趨溫和。高盛分析師Robert Quinn出具最新研報指出三個值得關注的信號：投機倉位調整、中國太陽能股票反彈，以及選擇權市場對下行風險的防範需求減弱。這些變化雖未確認觸底，但意味著多空力量正重新平衡。
根據芝加哥期交所(CFTC)數據顯示，在10月6日至11月3日期間，非商業帳戶累計賣出約23億美元白銀期貨部位，其中新增空頭約26億美元，多頭僅約3億美元，顯示拋售由新增空頭主導。投機淨多頭部位降至過去兩年區間第2百分位附近，持倉總規模從1月高峰的約240億美元降至約80億美元。
值得注意的是，上次類似持倉水平時，白銀價格接近每盎司30美元，但此次已達約50美元，看漲熱情雖大幅消退，但價格未同步回落。
白銀兼具貴金屬與工業金屬屬性，價格受美元、實際利率及太陽能等工業需求影響。上月拋售期間，美元走強、Fed升息預期升溫，加上中國太陽能與AI資料中心股票疲軟，加劇市場對工業需求的擔憂。
但11月3日美國期中選舉後，投資者預期中國太陽能廠面臨的政策環境有望趨於寬鬆。高盛中國太陽能類股組合隨後上漲7.1%，同期白銀價格反彈約6%。
過去六個月，管理基金白銀多頭部位與太陽能股表現呈正相關，但最新持倉數據尚未反映選舉後變化，避險基金是否重新買入仍待觀察。
選擇權市場亦現積極信號。白銀在10月拋售期間，下行保護需求曾升至疫情以來極端水平，但三個月期標準化25 Delta看跌/看漲偏斜指標已明顯回落，防範需求減弱。三個月期平值隱含波動率穩定在38%至39%，遠低於1月時超過100%的水平，顯示最激烈的恐慌情緒正在消退。
面對最新通膨數據，白銀反應相對溫和。美國10月CPI月增0.4%(預期0.3%)，核心CPI漲0.3%(預期0.2%)。數據公布後，兩年期美債殖利率上漲20基點，美元走強，升息預期再起。高盛預測2027年3月Fed升息，終點利率區間上調至4.25%—4.5%。該投行認為，相較過去類似情況，白銀對鷹派信號反應趨於溫和，市場對利空敏感度下降。
綜合而言，投機淨多頭近兩年低位、新增空頭明顯、太陽能股反彈及選擇權防範需求降溫，若需求預期改善，累積空頭可能面臨回補壓力，為白銀帶來上漲動力。
但高盛強調，白銀持續反彈趨勢尚未確立。美元仍受鷹派政策支撐，後續需觀察中國太陽能股反彈能否延續、投機者是否重建多頭，以及白銀能否在強美元下續漲。目前最值得關注的是，推動下跌的力量正在變化，一旦出現新催化劑，空頭回補有望成為反彈重要推力。
paras_en: Silver market trading dynamics are shifting. After weeks of selling, speculative net long positions have fallen to near two‑year lows, and silver's reaction to negative news has become more muted. Goldman Sachs analyst Robert Quinn highlighted three noteworthy signals in a new report: adjustments in speculative positions, a rebound in Chinese solar‑energy stocks, and weakened demand for downside protection in the options market. While these changes do not confirm a bottom, they suggest the bull‑bear forces are rebalancing.

CFTC data for the period October 6‑November 3 shows non‑commercial accounts sold roughly $2.3 billion of silver futures, adding about $2.6 billion of new short exposure versus only about $0.3 billion of new longs, indicating the sell‑off was driven by fresh shorts. Speculative net longs fell to around the 2nd percentile of the past two‑year range, and total open interest dropped from a January peak of about $24 billion to roughly $8 billion.

It is notable that the last time positions were at a similar level, silver was near $30 per ounce, whereas it now sits around $50. Bullish enthusiasm has faded sharply, yet the price has not fallen in step.

Silver straddles precious‑metal and industrial‑metal characteristics, with price influenced by the dollar, real rates and industrial demand such as solar‑energy. During last month’s sell‑off, a stronger dollar, hotter Fed‑rate‑hike expectations and weakness in Chinese solar‑energy and AI‑data‑center stocks heightened concerns over industrial demand.

However, after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, investors expected a more accommodative policy environment for Chinese solar firms. Goldman Sachs’ China solar‑stock basket subsequently rose 7.1%, while silver prices rebounded about 6% over the same period.

Over the past six months, managed‑fund silver longs have moved in tandem with solar‑stock performance, but the latest position data have not yet reflected the post‑election shift, leaving it uncertain whether hedge funds are buying back in.

Options market also shows an active signal. During the October sell‑off, demand for downside protection spiked to pandemic‑era extremes, but the 25‑Delta standardized put‑call skew for the three‑month term has clearly receded, indicating weaker hedging demand. At‑the‑money three‑month implied volatility has steadied at 38‑39%, far below the over‑100% level seen in January, suggesting the most intense panic is fading.

Silver’s reaction to the latest inflation data was relatively muted. U.S. CPI rose 0.4% month‑over‑month in October (vs. 0.3% forecast) and core CPI rose 0.3% (vs. 0.2% forecast). After the release, two‑year Treasury yields jumped 20 basis points, the dollar strengthened and rate‑hike expectations revived. Goldman Sachs projects a March 2027 Fed hike, lifting the terminal rate target to 4.25%‑4.5%. The bank believes silver now reacts more calmly to hawkish signals than in comparable past episodes, with market sensitivity to downside news diminishing.

In sum, speculative net longs are near two‑year lows, new shorts are pronounced, solar stocks have rebounded and options‑hedging demand has cooled. If demand expectations improve, the accumulated short side could face cover‑up pressure, providing upward momentum for silver.

Nevertheless, Goldman Sachs stresses that a sustained silver rally is not yet established. The dollar remains supported by hawkish policy, and future focus should be on whether the Chinese solar rebound endures, whether speculators rebuild long positions, and whether silver can keep climbing against a strong dollar. The key takeaway is that the forces driving the decline are changing, and a new catalyst could trigger short‑covering as a major driver of a rebound.

items.title: 全球佔比近八成！微短劇成網路流量新戰場：中國市場規模破140億美元 京東上線「追劇福利社」搶灘
items.title_en: Nearly 80% of Global Share! Micro‑short dramas become the new battlefield for online traffic: China market exceeds $14 billion, JD launches “Drama Benefits Club” to compete
paras: 最新數據顯示，微短劇已成為當前網路上最炙手可熱的流量密碼，去年全球微短劇市場規模接近180億美元，其中中國市場突破140億美元，以77.78%佔比主導全球市場。此外，中國國內用戶規模高達8.5億，顯示短劇成為各大網路巨頭爭相佈局的戰略高地。隨著京東在「雙11」期間悄然上線「京東追劇福利社」，一場圍繞短劇展開的電商與內容跨界混戰正式進入白熱化階段。
中國短劇的影響力早已跨越國界。2025年海外短劇應用總下載量達11.99億次，年增268%，總收入23.29億美元，年增率133%。
目前，搭載於各類串流媒體通路的中國微短劇應用已突破300款，涵蓋全球200多國和地區。在海外社交平台上，漢語拼音「duanju」甚至被直接用來指微短劇，這從側面上印證中國內容工業的強大輸出能力。
盤古智庫高級研究員江瀚分析指出，中國國內已跑通短劇工業化鏈條，成熟經驗正被複製到海外。海外用戶對強情節、快節奏內容接受度較高，而中國團隊的生產效率遠超當地團隊。此外，東方古裝題材在海外相對稀缺，強情節和情感衝突易引發共鳴，為中國短劇提供差異化競爭空間。
AI技術的加持讓短劇市場爆發式成。中國今年前8月上線微短劇43萬部，是去年全年的13倍，其中AI劇佔比超過九成，傳統真人短劇單部成本普遍在50萬至100萬元人民幣，而同樣水準的AI短劇成本僅需10-20萬元，製作週期更從「月」壓縮到「天」。
以AI短劇《持械入宋》為例，該劇兩個月內推出10季共1000集，累計播放量超過40億，但隨著製作門檻降低，同質化、低俗化問題隨之而來。
今年9月1日，中國《微短劇發展管理辦法》正式上路，規定AI生成內容需添加提示標識，並禁止使用誘導沉迷的算法模型。
中國國家廣電總局本月也啟動為期兩個月的專項治理，業內人士強調AI不能自動帶來優質內容，未來行業競爭的關鍵仍在於故事質量與精品化。
在中國市場，短劇已成為網路巨頭尋找新成長曲線的關鍵戰場。京東11月11日低調上線「京東追劇福利社」，產品頁面打出口號「看劇領福利、劇中同款直接買」。用戶可在微信內直接刷劇，劇集涵蓋都市、懸疑、重生等熱門題材。
不同於紅果短劇等主打免費內容與廣告變現的平台，京東的野心在於「內容導購」。早在2024年618購物節，京東就推出客製化戲劇《伍折天重生之女帝當總裁》試水。
京東此次推出獨立小應用程式，意在解決過去短劇多依附於購物場景、缺乏獨立追劇入口的痛點。雖然目前「劇中同款」的電商跳轉功能尚在測試，但其將短劇流量直接轉化為電商交易的意圖十分明顯。
除了京東，其他平台也基於自身基因探索不同路徑。紅果短劇走的是免費內容與獨立App路線，近期開始試水商城入口；淘寶推出「百億淘劇計劃」，側重品牌定制與站內營銷；拼多多則在多多視頻設立短劇入口，測試AI互動劇以增加用戶停留。
美團則將短劇與本地生活深度綁定，推出《黑桃四姐妹》等品牌冠名劇，將姐妹聚餐、城市探店等消費場景融入劇情，觀眾點擊組件即可跳轉至美團App的團購頁面。這與京東側重商品發現和購買的路徑形成差異，一個連接服務，一個連接貨架。
儘管各大平台雄心勃勃，但短劇作為消費入口並不天然等於業務增長。對於京東而言，如何證明短劇帶來的是新增訂單，而非將原本在App內完成的購物行為遷移到另一個入口，是必須面對的難題。此外，穩定的優質劇集供給、自然的商品植入，以及用戶在微信生態內持續追劇的習慣培養，都是考驗。
總體而言，短劇已從單純的娛樂產品演變為連接流量與商業的紐帶。中國短劇在全球市場的亮眼表現與國內巨頭的紛紛入局，預示著產業進入新階段。未來，誰能更好地平衡內容質量、用戶體驗與商業變現，誰就能在這場「短劇爭霸戰」中佔據先機。
paras_en: The latest data shows that micro‑short dramas have become the hottest traffic code online, with the global market size reaching close to $18 billion last year. China alone broke the $14 billion mark, accounting for 77.78% of the world market. Domestic Chinese users total 850 million, making short dramas a strategic high‑ground that major internet giants are racing to occupy. With JD quietly launching the “JD Drama Benefits Club” during the Double‑11 shopping festival, a fierce e‑commerce‑content crossover centered on short dramas has entered a boiling stage.

China’s short‑drama influence has already crossed borders. By 2025, overseas short‑drama app downloads are projected to hit 1.199 billion, a 268% year‑over‑year increase, with total revenue of $2.329 billion, up 133% annually.

Currently, more than 300 Chinese micro‑short‑drama apps are available across various streaming platforms, covering over 200 countries and regions. On overseas social media, the pinyin “duanju” is even used directly to refer to micro‑short dramas, underscoring the strong export capability of China’s content industry.

Senior researcher Jiang Han of the Pangu Think‑Tank notes that China has already completed the industrial chain for short dramas, and its mature experience is being replicated abroad. Overseas users favor strong plotlines and fast‑paced content, and Chinese teams produce far more efficiently than local crews. Moreover, Eastern historical‑costume themes are relatively scarce overseas; their intense plots and emotional conflicts resonate well, giving Chinese short dramas a differentiated competitive edge.

AI technology has sparked an explosive growth in the short‑drama market. In the first eight months of this year, China launched 430,000 micro‑short dramas—13 times the total of the previous year—with AI‑generated dramas accounting for over 90%. Traditional live‑action short dramas typically cost between 500,000 and 1 million RMB per episode, whereas comparable AI dramas cost only 100,000‑200,000 RMB, and production cycles have shrunk from months to days.

Take the AI short drama “Armed Entry into Song” as an example: it released 10 seasons and 1,000 episodes within two months, accumulating over 4 billion views. However, as production barriers fall, issues of homogenization and vulgarity are emerging.

On September 1 this year, China’s “Micro‑Short Drama Development Management Measures” officially took effect, requiring AI‑generated content to carry a disclaimer and prohibiting algorithmic models that encourage addictive behavior.

The State Administration of Radio and Television launched a two‑month special governance campaign this month. Industry insiders stress that AI alone cannot guarantee high‑quality content; future competition will still hinge on storytelling quality and premium production.

In the Chinese market, short dramas have become a key battlefield for internet giants seeking new growth curves. JD quietly rolled out the “JD Drama Benefits Club” on November 11, branding the product page with the slogan “Watch dramas, earn benefits; buy the featured items directly from the show.” Users can stream dramas within WeChat, with series covering popular themes such as urban life, suspense, and rebirth.

Unlike platforms like Hongguo Short Drama that focus on free content and ad monetization, JD’s ambition lies in “content‑driven shopping.” As early as the 2024 618 Shopping Festival, JD tested a customized drama titled “Wu Zhe Tian’s Rebirth: The Empress Becomes CEO.”

This time JD launched an independent mini‑app to address the pain point that most short dramas are tied to shopping scenes and lack a standalone viewing entry. Although the “in‑show product” e‑commerce link is still in testing, JD’s intent to convert drama traffic directly into transactions is clear.

Besides JD, other platforms are exploring different paths based on their own DNA. Hongguo Short Drama pursues a free‑content and standalone‑app route and has recently begun testing a mall entry; Taobao unveiled the “Hundred‑Billion Taodrama Plan,” focusing on brand‑customized and on‑site marketing; Pinduoduo added a short‑drama portal to Duoduo Video, experimenting with AI interactive dramas to boost user dwell time.

Meituan tightly binds short dramas with local life services, launching brand‑named series such as “Black‑Spade Four Sisters,” embedding dining, city‑exploration and other consumption scenarios into the storyline. Viewers can click components to jump to Meituan’s group‑buy page, contrasting JD’s focus on product discovery and purchase—one connects services, the other connects shelves.

Although platforms are ambitious, short dramas as a consumption entry point do not automatically translate into business growth. For JD, the challenge is proving that dramas generate new orders rather than merely shifting existing app purchases to a new entry. Stable supply of quality series, natural product placement, and cultivating users’ habit of watching dramas within the WeChat ecosystem are all critical tests.

Overall, short dramas have evolved from pure entertainment into a bridge linking traffic and commerce. The impressive global performance of Chinese short dramas and the flood of domestic giants into the space signal a new industry phase. Whoever can better balance content quality, user experience, and commercial monetization will seize the advantage in this “short‑drama showdown.”

items.title: 日本國防採購傳低於預期部分飛彈、軍機訂購量恐減半
items.title_en: Japan’s Defense Procurement May Fall Short of Expectations, Some Missile and Aircraft Orders Could Be Halved
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本擴充軍備的採購規模可能不如國防業者原先預期。市場傳出日本官員已向承包商示警，受財政空間限制，部分飛彈與軍機的計畫採購量可能最多削減一半，範圍涵蓋日本國內及海外供應商，也包括美製F-35戰機。
據了解，財務省官員上週提出，自2027年4月起的五年國防支出規模為50兆至60兆日圓。這仍高於現行五年計畫的43兆日圓，但低於部分防衛官員與自民黨議員原先設想的80兆日圓；後者先前也被用作與供應商洽談的基礎。新方案若獲採用，軍備採購的擴張幅度將低於原先預期。
日本主要國防承包商包括三菱重工(7011-JP)、三菱電機(6503-JP)與川崎重工(7012-JP)，F-35則由美國洛克希德馬丁(LMT-US)生產。三菱重工與三菱電機拒絕評論，川崎重工尚未立即回應。其中一名消息人士表示，無人機訂單不受此次預算提案調整影響。
這項支出方案尚未定案。防衛省表示，將先確認所需防衛能力，再編列預算；財務大臣片山皋月也稱，相關諮詢小組尚未討論到這類細節，目前不宜評論。首相高市早苗承諾加速強化防衛，政府預計年底修訂國家安全戰略與防衛計畫，但財務官員認為，促進經濟成長的投資與食品消費稅減稅承諾，同樣壓縮可用財源。

paras_en: November 13, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Japan’s expansion of its defense procurement may be smaller than defense firms originally expected. Sources say Japanese officials have warned contractors that, due to fiscal constraints, the planned purchase quantities for some missiles and aircraft could be cut by up to half, affecting both domestic and overseas suppliers, including the US‑made F‑35 fighter jet.

According to insiders, Ministry of Finance officials last week proposed a five‑year defense spending plan of ¥50‑60 trillion starting in April 2027. This is still higher than the current five‑year plan of ¥43 trillion, but lower than the ¥80 trillion figure originally envisioned by some defense officials and Liberal Democratic Party lawmakers, which had been used as a baseline in talks with suppliers. If adopted, the new plan would mean a smaller expansion of defense procurement than previously anticipated.

Japan’s major defense contractors include Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (7011‑JP), Mitsubishi Electric (6503‑JP) and Kawasaki Heavy Industries (7012‑JP), while the F‑35 is produced by US‑based Lockheed Martin (LMT‑US). Mitsubishi Heavy and Mitsubishi Electric declined to comment, and Kawasaki Heavy has not responded immediately. One source said drone orders are not affected by the budget proposal adjustment.

The spending plan has not yet been finalized. The Defense Ministry said it will first confirm the required defense capabilities before allocating the budget; Finance Minister Shigeyuki Katayama also said the relevant advisory panel has not yet discussed such details, so comment is premature. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged to accelerate defense strengthening, and the government expects to revise the National Security Strategy and Defense Plan by year‑end, but finance officials note that investments to boost economic growth and promised cuts to the consumption tax on food also squeeze available funds.

items.title: 迎接美股延長交易Citadel Securities擴大亞太團隊與辦公據點
items.title_en: Preparing for Extended US Stock Trading, Citadel Securities Expands Asia‑Pacific Team and Offices
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股交易朝近乎全天候運作發展，造市商Citadel Securities正擴大亞太布局。公司計畫將新加坡與雪梨辦公空間分別增加40%及65%，並於2027年持續招募交易員、技術人員與研究人員，準備承接亞洲客戶交易美股及跨境金融商品的需求。

Citadel Securities是全球主要的造市商與流動性提供者，業務橫跨股票、選擇權、固定收益與外匯市場，並擔任指定造市商（Designated Market Maker）。公司為金融機構提供流動性與企業解決方案，同時投入交易、量化研究、預測模型與大規模交易系統的開發，也向機構客戶提供市場觀點與政策立場。Citadel Securities成立於2001年，總部位於美國佛羅里達州邁阿密，是Cshc Us LLC旗下子公司。
Citadel Securities亞太區主管Vikesh Kotecha表示，公司向更多亞洲客戶提供美股交易流動性，並將服務延伸至美國夜間時段，因此需要擴充區域客戶服務能力。公司今年已在亞太地區增聘近100人，約半數位於香港，其餘分布於新加坡、雪梨、印度古爾岡與東京；亞太團隊目前約400人，全球員工則超過1,800人。
擴張不只著眼股票交易。Citadel Securities今年在亞洲推出美國投資等級信用商品及結構型商品業務，明年將繼續擴充，也正在申請設立中國境內證券公司。香港則是公司最早、也是規模最大的亞洲據點，近期已在中環國際金融中心二期增租半層辦公空間。
延長交易時間能否帶來足夠成交量，仍是業者布局的重要觀察。依Citadel Securities數據，美股盤前與盤後交易合計最高約占總交易量10%，夜間交易目前約占1%。Nasdaq與Cboe均規劃12月將美股交易延長至每週五天、每天23小時；Citadel Securities預期，這將增加亞洲時段的交易活動。

paras_en: November 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – As US equity trading moves toward near‑continuous operation, market‑maker Citadel Securities is expanding its Asia‑Pacific footprint. The firm plans to increase its office space in Singapore and Sydney by 40% and 65% respectively, and will continue hiring traders, technologists and researchers through 2027 to serve Asian clients’ demand for US equities and cross‑border financial products.

Citadel Securities is a leading global market‑maker and liquidity provider across equities, options, fixed income and foreign‑exchange markets, and acts as a Designated Market Maker. It supplies liquidity and corporate solutions to financial institutions, invests in trading, quantitative research, predictive models and large‑scale execution systems, and offers market viewpoints and policy stances to institutional clients. Founded in 2001 and headquartered in Miami, Florida, Citadel Securities is a subsidiary of Cshc US LLC.

Vikesh Kotecha, head of Citadel Securities’ Asia‑Pacific region, said the firm is extending US‑equity liquidity to more Asian clients and into US night‑time sessions, necessitating expanded regional client‑service capacity. This year the firm added nearly 100 staff in APAC, about half in Hong Kong and the rest in Singapore, Sydney, Gurgaon (India) and Tokyo; the APAC team now numbers roughly 400, while global headcount exceeds 1,800.

The expansion is not limited to equity trading. Earlier this year Citadel Securities launched US investment‑grade credit and structured product offerings in Asia and will continue to grow these lines next year, while also applying to establish a securities firm in mainland China. Hong Kong, the firm’s earliest and largest Asian hub, recently leased an additional half‑floor of office space in Phase II of the International Finance Centre in Central.

Whether the longer trading hours will generate sufficient volume remains a key focus for market participants. Citadel Securities data show that pre‑market and after‑hours US equity trading together account for at most about 10% of total volume, with night‑time trading currently around 1%. Both Nasdaq and Cboe plan to extend US equity trading to 23 hours a day, five days a week, starting in December, and Citadel expects this will boost activity during Asian sessions.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元升至19個月新高 市場焦點轉向利率預期
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Rises to 19-Month High, Market Focus Shifts to Rate Expectations
paras: 美元週四(12日)走強，升至約19個月以來最高水準。由於投資人重新評估聯準會（Fed）未來的利率政策走向，市場對聯準會採取更強硬升息立場的預期升高，進而推升美國公債殖利率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報103.16，仍維持在2025年4月以來的最高水準。
本週多位聯準會官員警告，通膨仍維持在頑強的高檔水準。其中一些官員表示，如果物價壓力未能緩解，他們不排除升息50個基點的可能性。
週二公布的美國通膨數據強於預期，進一步強化了這項看法，也促使交易員提高對聯準會進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。
歐元兌美元下跌0.28%，至1歐元兌1.10585美元，創下2025年4月以來最低。
美元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.14%，至0.834瑞郎，達到一個月以來新高。
Moneycorp交易與結構性商品部門主管 Eugene Epstein 表示，「美元走強幾乎完全是受到市場對聯準會政策預期的影響。如果觀察聯邦基金利率期貨，過去幾天它與美元走勢之間的相關性相當高。而聯邦基金利率期貨之所以走高，主要有兩個原因：（一）消費者物價指數（CPI）高於預期；（二）多位聯準會官員發表了相當多偏鷹的言論。」
根據芝商所（CME） FedWatch 工具，投資人目前預估聯準會在12月升息的機率已達91%。通常會隨聯準會利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率，最新上升10.79個基點，來到4.835%。美國10年期公債殖利率則上升7.94個基點，來到5.068%。
包括高盛在內的一些券商，目前甚至預期聯準會除了12月升息之外，明年初還可能再升息一次。
日元走勢
日本最高貨幣外交官三村淳（Atsushi Mimura）週四警告市場參與者，對於今年夏季日本政府曾進場干預匯市一事，「現在還不是可以忘記的時候」。
由於日元再次逼近1美元兌160日元重要關卡，市場對日本政府可能再次干預匯市的警戒也隨之升高。
根據《路透社》一項分析師調查，許多分析師預期，日本央行（BoJ）最快可能在下個月升息。週四公布數據也進一步強化了這項看法。數據顯示，日本10月份批發物價年增率重新加速至7.1%，高於9月份的6.8%。
日元兌美元下跌0.13%，至1美元兌159.975日元，創下9月以來最低水準。
澳幣兌美元下跌0.58%，至0.6808美元，創下今年1月以來最低。
紐幣兌美元則下跌0.25%，來到0.5548美元。

Investors reassessed the Fed’s future rate policy trajectory, raising expectations that the Fed will adopt a more aggressive rate‑hike stance, which in turn pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to 103.16, still holding its peak since April 2025.
Several Fed officials this week warned that inflation remains stubbornly high. Some officials said that if price pressures do not ease, they would not rule out a 50‑basis‑point rate hike.
U.S. inflation data released on Tuesday came in stronger than expected, reinforcing that view and prompting traders to raise expectations for further tightening by the Fed.

The dollar rose 0.14% against the Swiss franc to 0.834 franc, a one‑month high.

Looking at fed‑fund futures, the correlation with the dollar’s move has been very high over the past few days. Fed‑fund futures are rising for two main reasons: (1) CPI came in above expectations; (2) a number of Fed officials have made decidedly hawkish comments.”

As the yen again approached the critical 160‑per‑dollar threshold, market vigilance over a possible renewed intervention by the Japanese government rose.

items.title: 日元逼近160關卡！日本匯率主管再警告市場勿忘夏季干預 暗示可能單獨出手
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Barrier! Japan's Exchange Rate Chief Warns Market Not to Forget Summer Intervention, Hints at Possible Solo Action
paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the 160 level, a key threshold where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign‑exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange‑rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the FX market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late‑August early‑August yen‑buying intervention, which was carried out in coordination with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S. That three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.
A weaker yen is pushing up import costs, raising inflation pressure in Japan. Data released on Thursday showed that the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation at elevated levels, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo authorities may resort to unilateral intervention."

items.title: 美元飆上19個月高點！全球市場迎新風暴 聯準會12月升息幾無懸念
items.title_en: Dollar Soars to 19-Month High! Global Markets Face New Storm as Fed December Rate Hike Becomes All but Certain
paras: 美國通膨持續升溫，加上聯準會（Fed）官員接連釋出鷹派訊號，市場升息預期急速升溫，ICE 美元指數周三（11 日）一度升至 102.96，創下 19 個月新高。
隨著交易員開始押注聯準會 12 月可能一口氣升息 2 碼，短期美債殖利率飆升，全球主要貨幣普遍承壓，美元漲勢成為市場關注焦點。
隨著交易員開始將聯準會 12 月升息 2 碼納入定價，美債殖利率走揚、全球主要貨幣承壓，美元成為金融市場關注焦點。
行情數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的 ICE 美元指數(DXY) ，周三盤中最高觸及 102.96，創下 2025 年 4 月以來最高水準。
另一項廣受市場關注的彭博美元指數，也創下今年 6 月以來最大兩日漲幅，盤中觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。美元當天兌幾乎所有主要貨幣均走強，顯示買盤持續湧入。
美元本波漲勢在周二明顯加速，主要受到美國通膨數據與聯準會官員鷹派言論雙重推動。
最新數據顯示，美國 10 月消費者物價漲幅連續第三個月高於市場預期，促使交易員重新評估聯準會未來升息幅度，甚至開始將 12 月一次升息 50 個基點（2 碼）的可能性納入定價。
隨著短期美債殖利率飆升，美國與其他主要經濟體之間的利差擴大，進一步吸引追求較高報酬的資金流向美元資產。
12月升息1碼機率達88% 華爾街上修預測
加拿大帝國商業銀行（CIBC）策略師 Jeremy Stretch 表示，美元近期走強，核心原因在於市場持續重新調整對聯準會貨幣政策路徑的預期。
他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。
除了美元走強，法國債務問題持續拖累歐元，加上近期油價回落，市場對歐洲央行升息的預期也有所降溫。
荷蘭合作銀行（Rabobank）外匯策略師 Jane Foley 指出，歐洲央行上次新聞發布會透露，管理委員會對經濟成長前景的擔憂日益加深。
她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month peak.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

Another widely‑watched gauge, the Bloomberg Dollar Index, also posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that U.S. consumer price inflation for October was higher than market expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.
As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the yield gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% as Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in a single move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How high can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could see the dollar give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening yield differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute part of the dollar’s strength this year to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking below the 1.11‑dollar mark and extending the decline from the previous trading day, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and a recent pullback in oil prices has cooled expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank foreign‑exchange strategist Jane Foley noted that the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a victory by a far‑right candidate could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects that the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes continue to rise, markets will closely monitor U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.

paras: 美元對主要貨幣周三(11日)攀高，聯準會(Fed)官員接連發表鷹派談話，加上美國通膨數據比預期火熱，正在助長聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.68%，報102.90，盤中觸及2025年4月以來最高水準。
美元兌日元升值0.69%，報159.84日元，升至逾兩個月來最高水準，並逼近心理關卡160日元。
歐元兌美元貶值0.65%，報1.11美元，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及2025年5月以來最低水準。
美國10月消費者物價連續第三個月高於預期，促使交易員進一步提高對Fed 12月升息的押注。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場預期聯準會12月升息1碼(25個基點)的機率，已從一個月前約70%升至87%。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，升息預期升高有助於支撐美元。
Haddad表示：「美元普遍走強，主要受到Fed利率預期轉趨鷹派支撐。這項轉變由高於預期的10月CPI數據推動，近期Fed官員的談話也進一步放大了這股趨勢。」
包括Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)及達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)在內的官員都表示，對通膨居高不下感到不安，華勒甚至不排除大幅升息2碼(50個基點)的可能性，進一步推升市場升息押注。

高盛與德銀調整預測 今年多數主要貨幣走貶

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Wednesday (11th), as Fed officials delivered a series of hawkish remarks and U.S. inflation data outpaced expectations, boosting the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.68% to 102.90, hitting its highest level since April 2025 during the session.
The dollar strengthened 0.69% against the yen, trading at 159.84 yen, its highest level in over two months and approaching the psychological 160‑yen barrier.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar, trading at 1.11 dollars, continuing its decline from the previous day and reaching its lowest level since May 2025.

U.S. October consumer price inflation exceeded expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to raise their bets on a Fed rate hike in December. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in December rose from about 70% a month ago to 87%.
Elias Haddad, Global Market Strategy Head at Brown Brothers Harriman, said that higher rate‑hike expectations help support the dollar.

Haddad added, “The dollar is broadly stronger, largely due to the shift toward hawkish Fed rate expectations. This shift is driven by October CPI data that beat forecasts, and recent Fed officials’ remarks have further amplified the trend.”

Fed officials, including Governor Christopher Waller and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, expressed concern over persistently high inflation, with Waller even not ruling out a substantial 50‑basis‑point hike, further lifting market rate‑hike bets.

The pound fell 0.50% against the dollar, trading at 1.33 dollars, near its lowest point in two weeks. The dollar rose 0.93% against the Swiss franc, trading at 0.833 francs, briefly reaching its highest level since mid‑October.
Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank revised forecasts, expecting most major currencies to depreciate this year.

After the Tuesday inflation data release, some brokers adjusted their Fed policy outlooks. Goldman now expects rate hikes in December and March next year, while Deutsche Bank projects hikes in December, January, and March next year.

Except for the Australian dollar and Norwegian krone, most developed‑market currencies have weakened against the dollar this year, driven by widening interest‑rate spreads that lift the dollar. Some analysts also attribute the dollar’s strength to risk‑off flows during the U.S.‑Israel conflict with Iran.
The Australian dollar fell 0.23% against the dollar, trading at 0.685 dollars, while the dollar rose 0.61% against the Norwegian krone, trading at 9.55 krone.
In crypto, Bitcoin rose 0.93% to $74,460.41, and Ethereum climbed 1.19% to $2,079.31.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the “single currency law package” by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate the process to ensure the overall preparation work has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on 10 November, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that “Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different.” He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s reliance on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: “It will be a complementary means to cash, never a replacement.”

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data protection, transaction fee structures and individual holding limits.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Resurge, Yen Falls to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Barrier
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak performance in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday, marking a new low of about one and a half months since late September.

Market analysis points out that U.S. CPI data that came in above expectations sparked expectations of Fed rate hikes, causing U.S. Treasury yields to surge and widening the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, attracting carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, further pushing the yen lower.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have made hawkish remarks, also providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said before the inflation data release that if core inflation hits 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider evaluating a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) rate hike next month. After the data were released, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that stronger inflation might require a faster pace of hikes; Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee was even more blunt, calling the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata, an economist at the First Life Economic Research Institute, offered a different view. Katsurahata believes the market’s speculation that the Fed will raise rates by 2 points in December is an overreaction; as the market pricing settles at a 1‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is expected to be limited.

At the same time, analysts think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to prevent further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show that policymakers remain highly vigilant about inflation upside risks and support taking additional tightening measures. Affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark government bond yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued depreciation boosts the profitability of Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials have significantly increased corporate burdens and sparked domestic consumer price pressures.

paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”
